jobs.title: AI R&D Engineer – Model Training  (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Our Mission Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. Team Culture At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other. About the Role As an AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri. You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals. No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term. We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models. Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work. Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates. The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming. Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg. We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes. Requirements At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before. As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor. Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful: Test Driven Development (TDD) Trunk based development Continuous integration Domain Driven Design Nice-to-haves Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase. Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes. We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus. jobs.description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. DashOS connects these tools with the demand and growth learnings of the DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo marketplaces, so merchants can grow both on our marketplaces and on their own channels. In EMEA, we are building DashOS market by market. The team is small and works like a startup within the larger DoorDash. When joining DashOS, you will help shape a new business from an early stage: what we offer merchants to fuel their growth, how we take it to market and how we support merchants once they are live. Our Strategy & Operations team builds the DashOS business end to end in EMEA: what we focus on, how we measure success, and the playbooks that make growth repeatable. We work in small cross-functional pods that find improvement opportunities, launch and iterate, together with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Legal, Marketing, our merchant and consumer teams. About the Role We are now looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Operations to build the commercial engine behind DashOS. You will own the systems, numbers and operating rhythm that turn a multi-product strategy into predictable revenue, across all DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo markets in EMEA. jobs.title: Das Gesicht unserer Brand auf TikTok

Unser ONE Armband ist kein Accessoire, es ist ein Statement für Menschen, die nicht laut sein müssen, um gesehen zu werden. Jetzt bringen wir TRIONE auf TikTok. Nicht mit Countdowns und Rabattcodes, sondern mit Ästhetik, Haltung und Geschichten. Mit Videos und ausgewählten Livestreams aus unserem eigenen Store, von unseren Events und von Orten, die so besonders sind wie unsere Pieces. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die unsere Welt vor der Kamera spürbar macht. Deine Rolle Du bist das Gesicht von TRIONE auf TikTok, in Videos und in Livestreams aus unserem Store, von exklusiven Events und luxuriösen Locations Du erzählst die Geschichten hinter unseren Pieces, nicht ihre Preise Du gestaltest mit uns Content, der sich anfühlt wie die Brand selbst: ruhig, ästhetisch, selbstbewusst Du bist dabei, wenn eine Brand ihre nächste Ebene erreicht Was dich ausmacht Natürliche Präsenz vor der Kamera Ein Auge für Ästhetik, Fashion und Details Du verstehst TikTok und weißt, was Menschen wirklich innehalten lässt Stil, Verlässlichkeit und sehr gutes Deutsch Was dich erwartet Sichtbarkeit als Gesicht einer Brand, die man nicht übersieht Einladungen zu unseren exklusiven Events und Zugang zu unserem Netzwerk aus Creatorn und Partnern Pieces aus unserer Kollektion Ein kleines Team, kurze Wege und echter Einfluss auf das, was entsteht Flexible Zeiten neben Uni oder Job Für wen Diese Stelle ist als Pflichtpraktikum ausgeschrieben und richtet sich an Studierende, die laut Studien- oder Prüfungsordnung ihrer Hochschule ein Pflichtpraktikum absolvieren müssen. jobs.title: Full Stack Flutter Engineer – PHP/Go (m/f/x)
jobs.description: Your mission About SIDES Restaurants are where people come together over good food. We build the technology that keeps them running. SIDES is the operating system for hospitality: POS, payments, delivery, kitchen tools, self-order terminals, apps and webshops on one platform. Thousands of restaurants run on it and millions of transactions flow through it every month, peaking on a Friday night when nothing is allowed to fail. We have the owner's and the chef's back, so they can focus on their food and their guests. And it is not just code on a screen: our software runs on real hardware in real restaurants, from POS devices to self-order terminals and more. We love AI. These are wild times for software engineers, and we want to make the most of them: AI is part of every workflow at SIDES, and we are looking for people who are as excited about that as we are. Everyone on the team uses tools like Claude every day to write and review code, explore unfamiliar parts of the codebase, write tests and get from idea to shipped feature faster. jobs.title: Lead Systems Engineer (Orbital Launch)
jobs.description: Lead Systems Engineer We are looking for a Lead Systems Engineer to act as the Systems Technical Authority for our orbital rocket programme. You will lead the vehicle-level systems effort, maintaining a coherent technical view of the complete vehicle and leading the definition, management, and resolution of system interfaces. Working with multidisciplinary teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and more, you will manage the interdependencies between technical departments and use model-based systems engineering (MBSE) to keep system-level decisions connected. Your work will lay the technical foundation for successful vehicle integration and launch. About us We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you. jobs.title: (Senior) Project Manager – Industrialization (all genders)
jobs.description: Your Mission: As (Senior) Project Manager – Industrialization (all genders), you will lead the delivery of our multi-year, large-scale EU-Innovation Fund project CAROLUS for the industrialisation of VÆRIDION's Microliner, including the set-up of our first Final Assembly Line at Oberpfaffenhofen Airport. Positioned within Programme Management and working closely with Finance, you will translate grant commitments into an integrated delivery plan and ensure that milestones, deliverables, and funding obligations are met on time, within budget, and in line with EU funding rules. You will coordinate activities across engineering, certification, operations, finance, and external partners, and act as the main point of contact for the funding authority. Depending on capacity, you will also support further EU and national grant projects, from proposal preparation through to day-to-day project management. Your Day-to-Day: Lead our flagship industrialisation grant Lead the end-to-end management of our CAROLUS grant project, from grant signature through industrialisation and entry into operation. Develop and maintain the integrated project plan, milestone schedule, and deliverable roadmap, aligned with the company's master schedule. Drive the completion of milestones and deliverables, ensuring that evidence is complete, consistent, and submitted on time. Establish and run project governance, including steering committee meetings, risk management, escalation, and change control processes. Coordinate engineering, certification, operations, and facility activities across internal teams and external stakeholders. Prepare periodic and annual reports, covering technical progress, emission reduction performance, and knowledge sharing. Act as the main point of contact for the funding authority, managing reporting obligations, communication, and grant amendments. Ensure compliance with funding, environmental, and visibility requirements, and maintain audit readiness throughout the project lifecycle. jobs.description: Meet Arago and the Aragonians Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles. The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance. Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders. Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work. What you’ll do As DFT Engineer, you will define and own the Design-for-Test strategy of our next-generation SoC from the ground up. This is not a role where you inherit an existing flow, scripts, or team — you build it. You will work closely with RTL design, physical implementation, and our test partners to make our chips manufacturable, testable, and ready for volume production. Required Skills and Experience 10+ years in DFT, with at least one full SoC tape-out owned end-to-end — not just one slice of a large team effort. Strong hands-on experience with one major DFT suite: Siemens Tessent, Synopsys TestMAX / DFTMAX / TetraMAX, or Cadence Modus. Scan insertion and test compression (EDT / DFTMAX / Modus-type). MBIST and memory repair integration. JTAG / IEEE 1149.1, IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), IEEE 1500 wrappers. ATPG pattern generation (stuck-at, transition, path delay), coverage analysis and improvement. DFT verification: gate-level simulation of patterns, timing-aware checks. Test-mode SDC / STA understanding. Scripting: Tcl, Python. Experience in silicon bring-up and ATE debug. Language: English at a proficient level. Responsibilities Define DFT architecture and test strategy — coverage targets, test time, pin budget — in collaboration with Siemens experts and our design team. Implement hands-on: scan insertion, compression, MBIST, JTAG/IJTAG/IEEE 1500 wrappers, ATPG, sign-off. Drive DFT verification: gate-level simulation of test patterns and timing-aware checks. Support physical design and STA for test modes — constraints, scan timing closure. Be the bridge between RTL design, physical implementation, and the ATE / test house for silicon bring-up. Deliver patterns to ATE and debug failing patterns with the test house. Contribute to DFT tool evaluation and set up a reusable, scalable flow. Preferred Qualification Experience at advanced nodes (7nm and below). Experience with large AI/HPC or multi-core SoCs, NoC-based designs. Hierarchical DFT on large designs. Has participated in a DFT tool selection or flow setup from scratch. Logic BIST, in-system test, or functional safety (ISO 26262) exposure. Yield analysis and diagnosis (e.g. Tessent Diagnosis, YieldInsight). Pay and benefits Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions. Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers). Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays. Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive. jobs.title: Thermo-Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engines, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours. We are seeking a talented Thermo-Mechanical Engineer to join our Future Project division. As a key member of our engineering team, you will be responsible for designing, analyzing, and optimizing combustion devices for cryogenic rocket engines, with a focus on the main thrust chamber assembly. Key Responsibilities Support structural and thermal analysis of combustion device hardware including injector heads, faceplates, combustion chambers, manifolds, and structural interfaces. Perform finite element analysis (FEA) and establish practical design suggestions and establish design recommendations, and margin assessments for hardware development. Develop and apply analytical and reduced-order models to estimate heat transfer, structural loads, and thermal boundary conditions to inform design trades and hardware maturation. Support hardware development and maturation, including design iteration, development planning, test definition, and post-test assessment of structural and thermal performance. Drive life assessment activities, including low-cycle fatigue, thermal fatigue, cyclic loading, margin tracking, and damage accumulation for reusable hardware. Own structural reliability and lifecycle assessments of combustion hardware, including low-cycle fatigue, thermal fatigue, cyclic loading, and thermo-mechanical failure risk evaluation. Collaborate with combustion and fluid engineers to translate predicted heat flux distributions, pressure fields, and flow characteristics into structural and thermal design requirements Define structural and thermal instrumentation strategies for development testing and participate post-test data reduction, model validation, and correlation activities. Contribute to material selection and design trades considering temperature capability, strength, fatigue resistance, oxidation compatibility, and cryogenic behavior. Prepare technical documentation and contribute to design, and test reviews with clear technical justification and risk assessment. What we would love to see from you Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Experience (academic, internship, or professional) in structural or thermal analysis of high-performance mechanical systems. Strong fundamentals in solid mechanics, heat transfer, and pressure-loaded structures. Experience with FEA tools such as ANSYS, NASTRAN, Abaqus, or equivalent. Ability to interpret complex thermal and pressure boundary conditions and apply them appropriately in structural models. Understanding of fatigue, temperature-dependent material behavior, and nonlinear structural response. Exposure to high-temperature or cryogenic systems is advantageous. Familiarity with CAD (NX ideally) tools and ability to work directly with geometry. Experience with Python or similar scripting tools for analysis automation or data processing is beneficial. Skills and Behaviours Methodical and structured approach to problem solving. Strong attention to detail and analytical rigor. Clear written and verbal communication of technical rationale. Ability to iterate analyses as design and test data evolve. Interest in propulsion systems and combustion device development. Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence, and Teamwork. Why you should join us! What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate

We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.&nbsp;</p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h4><strong>Please submit your CV in English!</strong></h4> <h4><strong>The opportunity:</strong></h4> <p>The role of the Operations Associate is a critical part of making Flexport’s mission to make global trade easy for everyone a reality. Flexport today connects almost 10,000 clients and suppliers across 109 countries. In this role, your direct customers are the partners within your region: our account management and customs teams, subcontractors, carriers, terminals and trucking providers. Your work directly supports Flexport’s end customers in achieving their logistics goals. Most importantly, you will play a pivotal role in building the next operational model at Flexport: allowing us to effectively scale to achieve our mission of making global trade easier for everyone.</p> <p>This role is designed to facilitate the movement of shipments while discovering and driving efficiencies that build and improve operations as part of our Global team. You will be responsible for ensuring that all customer shipments are executed according to plan, on time and within budget. As the person who manages movement in your region with laser focus, you have the unique opportunity to help your regional account team spot opportunities to improve and grow our customers’ business. You will drive impact through surfacing new ideas to eliminate waste, improve customer experience or introducing innovative ways of managing a supply chain.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be the “front line” in ensuring the highest standard of Flexport quality: shipments move on-time and exceptions are handled appropriately</li> <li>Be responsible for ensuring your work satisfies internal KPIs and SLAs that demonstrate quality delivery</li> <li>Follow standard operating procedures (SOP)</li> <li>Solve client issues quickly and ensure smooth operations at origin and destination and escalate issues as needed</li> <li>Acting in the best interest of the company by avoiding leakages and ensuring cost conscious behavior&nbsp;</li> <li>Seamlessly coordinate day-to-day logistics operations with internal and external partners such as steamship lines, air carriers, intermodal and drayage vendors, customs, trade lane management, warehousing, transloading, trucking, and the air operations team</li> <li>Execute the end-to-end movement of freight shipments within a regional network (both imports and exports), including intermodal movements</li> <li>Assist the shipments managed by partners as we drive partner autonomy (if applicable in a given region)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Prerequisites:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BA/BS Degree or completed professional training as forwarding agent</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>3+ years of experience in

jobs.title: Financial Crime Compliance, Senior Analyst
jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Please only apply using an English CV. We're hiring for a passionate FinCrime problem solver to join the Financial Crime Compliance team in Paris and help protect the future of real-time payments. As a Senior Analyst, you will use your expertise in AML and complex onboarding to solve complex challenges in one of the world’s fastest-growing fintech environments. The Financial Crime Compliance team is the engine ensuring we grow safely. Key Responsibilities Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Lead deep-dive investigations into high-risk corporate entities and complex ownership structures (UBOs). SARs/STRs Management: Identify suspicious patterns and draft high-quality Suspicious Activity Reports (Déclarations de Soupçon) for submission to TRACFIN. Regulatory Advisory: Act as a subject matter expert on French AML/CFT laws (Monetary and Financial Code) and help the MLRO translate these into scalable operational processes. Transaction Monitoring: Analyze real-time alerts and historical data to identify emerging financial crime trends. Process Optimization: Don't just follow the manual—help write it. You’ll identify gaps in our automated screening and monitoring tools and propose data-driven solutions. Audit & Liaison: Support the MLRO during regulatory onsite inspections or internal audits, providing clear rationales for risk-based decisions. About you Experience: 5+ years in Financial Crime, AML, or Compliance, ideally within a FinTech, Payment Service Provider (PSP), or a high-volume Tier 1 bank. Local Expertise: Deep understanding of the French regulatory landscape (ACPR, TRACFIN) and the 5th/6th Anti-Money Laundering Directives. The "Investigator" Mindset: You enjoy "following the money" and have a proven ability to synthesize complex data into clear, actionable risk assessments. Tech-Savvy: Comfortable working with SQL, Python, or advanced data visualization tools (Looker/Tableau) to hunt for anomalies. Communication: Fluent in French and English. You can explain a complex regulatory requirement to a Product Manager just as easily as you can to a Regulator. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Permanent Control
jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Please make your application, including your CV, in English Language . We are a global compliance team headquartered out of London. About the role As a Senior Analyst – Permanent Controls , you will join the Permanent Controls team, a global Second Line of Defence (2LoD) function based across Paris and Mauritius. Reporting directly to the Head of Permanent Controls within the Compliance department, you will focus on the financial perimeter, exercising second-line control, independent oversight, and framework monitoring over the organization's finance domain. You will partner closely with the First Line of Defence (1LoD) to establish control standards, design control matrices, and provide guidance when needed. You will also execute 2LoD control plans, issue formal findings, and track recommendations through to resolution. Sitting in the Second Line of Defense, the global Permanent Controls team serves as an ongoing, trusted advisor and objective challenge to operational teams (1LoD), helping them design robust controls and ensure operational integrity across the organization. Unlike periodic audit functions, Permanent Controls operates continuously to proactively identify vulnerabilities, standardize control frameworks, and foster a strong risk culture. Note on Governance: This is a 2LoD function focused on ongoing control design, execution, and 1LoD enablement. It is distinct and independent from the Internal Audit (3LoD) function within Checkout.com. Key responsibilities Control Design: Collaborate with stakeholders to translate identified risks into comprehensive 2nd line control plans, standards, and templates. 1LoD Enablement: Partner with the First Line of Defence teams to design, refine, and assess their control matrices, ensuring alignment with internal standards and regulators' expectations (ACPR, FCA..). Execution & Testing: Formalize and execute second line permanent controls across critical perimeters, including: Financial regulatory reporting across global entities (France, UK, US, etc.). Accuracy of financial data, accounting standards, and reconciliations. Internal financial processes, procedures, and statutory compliance (including the Order of 3 December 2014). Safeguarding mechanisms (flow of funds, compliance with safeguarding measures, timelines, and incident monitoring). Reporting & Escalation: Present detailed control findings and anomaly reports to the Head of Permanent Controls; track the implementation of remediation recommendations. Proactive Continuous Improvement: Identify operational control gaps, take the initiative to propose practical solutions, and drive improvements to the overall control framework. Tooling & Automation: Contribute to the implementation and optimization of automated control tools, tracking dashboards, and recommendation monitoring systems whenever possible. About You Experience: 5 years of experience in Financial Audit, Internal Control, or Financial Reporting within the financial services (banking, Fintech..) or payments industry. Regulator

jobs.title: Testeur QA / Recette fonctionnelle (H/F) – Mission à mi-temps - FREELANCE
jobs.description: ImaginePartners recherche, pour l’un de ses clients, un testeur QA fonctionnel (H/F) pour une mission de 6 mois à mi-temps . Vous interviendrez sur plusieurs projets d’évolution du système d’information, dans un environnement principalement Microsoft. Votre rôle sera de valider les applications avant leur mise en production, de la préparation des tests à la vérification des corrections. Modalités de la mission Démarrage — Dès que possible Durée — 6 mois Rythme — Mi-temps, avec une répartition des jours à convenir Localisation — Région de Marseille, avec possibilité de travailler à distance TJM — À proposer Vos missions Analyser les besoins métiers et les spécifications, identifier les parcours à tester et définir la stratégie de test de chaque projet. Concevoir les scénarios, les cas de test et les jeux de données. Préparer et maintenir les plans de test. Exécuter les tests fonctionnels, d’intégration, de non-régression et de bout en bout. Participer aux campagnes de recette avant les mises en production. Qualifier et documenter les anomalies, suivre leur correction avec les développeurs et effectuer les contre-tests. Prioriser les campagnes entre les projets, communiquer les résultats aux équipes métiers et techniques et contribuer à harmoniser les pratiques de test. Profil recherché Vous avez une expérience significative en tests logiciels ou en recette fonctionnelle d’applications web ou de systèmes d’information d’entreprise. Vous savez mener une campagne de test en autonomie, documenter vos résultats et gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle. Vous avez utilisé Azure DevOps, Jira ou un outil équivalent, dans un environnement Agile/Scrum ou en cycle en V. Une expérience sur Power Platform, Dynamics 365 ou SharePoint , la certification ISTQB Foundation et la pratique de l’ automatisation des tests sont appréciées. Pour postuler Joignez votre CV à votre candidature sur JOIN et indiquez votre date de disponibilité , votre localisation , v otre TJM HT et votre disponibilité à mi-temps . jobs.title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the Role As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.  On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,  generating opportunities via outbound outreach.  We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London. This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if:  You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less. You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact. You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. In this role, you will:   Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners. Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com) Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices Minimum requirements for the role: 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles Excellent communication skil

jobs.title: Product Manager (m/w/d) 100%
jobs.description: Im Auftrag unseres Kunden HINT AG suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) 100% Gesundheitswesen sicher digitalisiert Wir decken die ICT-Bedürfnisse der Schweizer Spitäler, Heime und Praxen ab, sodass sich diese voll und ganz auf ihre Arbeit konzentrieren können. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Bereich Service Management suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n Product Manager Deine Aufgaben Du kennst das Gesundheitswesen und weisst, was Leistungserbringer im Alltag bewegt. Du entwickelst gerne Angebote, kannst Menschen dafür gewinnen und bringst die Umsetzung voran. Bei uns verbindest du Branchenwissen mit kommerziellem Gespür und gestaltest Produkte und Services mit konkretem Kundennutzen. Du bringst dein Verständnis für die Abläufe und Herausforderungen von Spitälern, Heimen und Praxen in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produktstrategie und unseres Portfolios ein. Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse und Marktpotenziale und entwickelst daraus gemeinsam mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Partnern passende, standardisierte und wirtschaftliche Angebote. Du führst die Beteiligten zusammen, klärst Anforderungen und Verantwortlichkeiten und treibst die Entwicklung und Markteinführung unserer Produkte und Services voran. Du unterstützt Sales und Account Management in Kundengesprächen, Workshops und Angebotspräsentationen. Dabei vermittelst du den fachlichen und wirtschaftlichen Nutzen unserer Leistungen überzeugend. Du präsentierst unsere Angebote und relevante Digitalisierungsthemen bei Kundenveranstaltungen, Fachanlässen und in Vorträgen. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Sales und Marketing die Positionierung, Verkaufsargumente und Unterlagen für eine erfolgreiche Vermarktung. Du kalkulierst Produktkosten mit den zuständigen Fachbereichen, wirkst bei Preisen und Verrechnungsmodellen mit und beurteilst die Wirtschaftlichkeit des Portfolios. Du begleitest den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus von der Einführung über die Weiterentwicklung bis zur Ablösung und lässt Rückmeldungen aus Vertrieb und Betrieb gezielt einfliessen. Du stellst verständliche und aktuelle Produktinformationen im Servicekatalog und Webshop sicher und wirkst bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres standardisierten Hardware-Sortiments mit. Dein Profil Du kennst das Schweizer Gesundheitswesen aus eigener Berufserfahrung, vorzugsweise direkt bei einem Leistungserbringer wie einem Spital, Heim oder Praxisverbund. Du verstehst klinische, pflegerische oder administrative Abläufe und erkennst, wo digitale Lösungen im Alltag einen Mehrwert schaffen. Du bringst Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, Business Development, Lösungsvertrieb oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion an der Schnittstelle zwischen Gesundheitswesen, ICT und Markt mit. Du kannst verkaufen: Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse, formulierst überzeugende Nutzenargumente und begeisterst unterschiedliche Anspruchsgruppen für eine Lösung. jobs.title: Control & Estimation Intern
jobs.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on. These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation. Your mission The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions. Responsibilities Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment. Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines. Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware. Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results and conclusions. Flight test participation: Actively take part in flight test sessions to validate the developed algorithms in operational conditions, and contribute to their real-time deployment. Candidates Requirements Educational background: Strong academic record in automatic control, applied mathematics, or a related field. Knowledge of state estimation (Kalman filtering, observers) and nonlinear or adaptive control is a strong plus. Technical skills : Solid understanding of control theory fundamentals and proficiency in Python or C++ is a plus. Experience with drones is a major plus. Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous, rigorous and able to take initiative. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. jobs.description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other. The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp. This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues.   What you’ll be doing You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues. You’ll be: Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline. Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers. Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing. With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors. As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers. We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them. Our Tech Stack At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.   Your role In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture. Delivery : Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience.  Direction : Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose. Talent : Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent. Culture : Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture. Craft : Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends. AI-first engineering : Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team's standards high while the way of working changes.   Your profile 3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures. Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams. Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design. Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work. Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same.

Lead complex, cross-functional risk initiatives with potential enterprise application, translating strategy and regulatory expectations into practical improvements across ClearBank Europe and the wider ClearBank Group. Resolve complex and emerging risks issues, including non-performing exposures, through decisive intervention, recovery and escalation. Shape scalable policies, appetite, controls and governance for growth and regulatory change. Act as a recognised expert and trusted adviser, influencing senior stakeholders through expertise, sound judgement and constructive challenge. Align functions on competing priorities, ownership and enterprise risk outcomes. Build capability through coaching, delegation and knowledge sharing. As a leading Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Integrator, we support some of the world’s most iconic brands in their transition to automation. Why this role matters Ready to move the world of intralogistics with tech? Join us as a Service Account Manager. Successful team members demonstrate a continuous improvement mindset, collaborate effectively across functions, and contribute to collective success. Monitor contractual performance, service levels, and commercial commitments while ensuring alignment between customer expectations and operational delivery. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance system reliability, service quality, and the overall customer experience. Build trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders, from operational teams to senior leadership, acting as a long-term partner to their business. Requirements Experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, Warehouse Operations, or Service Delivery. Commercial awareness with the ability to identify growth opportunities within existing accounts. jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Platform Engineer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Achter elke krachtige applicatie staat een stabiele en schaalbare cloudinfrastructuur. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Platform Engineer . Iemand die zelfstandig complete IT-omgevingen ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert. Je pakt complexe migraties van A tot Z op en bouwt met visie aan een ijzersterk platform. Jouw rol Als Platform Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van requirements tot oplevering. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert moderne IT-infrastructuur voor uitdagende klantprojecten. Met tools zoals Terraform en Ansible til je onze automatisering naar het hoogste niveau. Je begeleidt complexe klantmigraties van A tot Z met oog voor detail. Daarnaast borg je een uitstekende overdracht en heldere documentatie voor je collega's. Zo creëer je voorspelbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige omgevingen voor maatschappelijk relevante organisaties. Wat je zal gaan doen: Ontwerpen en opbouwen van schaalbare IT-infrastructuur op basis van klantvereisten. Automatiseren van omgevingen en processen met Terraform, Ansible en scripting. Zelfstandig uitvoeren en begeleiden van complexe klantmigraties. Inrichten van krachtige cloud- en Linux-omgevingen op platformen zoals Scaleway, AWS en Azure, volgens de nieuwste standaarden. Opstellen van heldere documentatie en verzorgen van een vlekkeloze kennisoverdracht. Waarborgen van de veiligheid, capaciteit en performance van het platform. Adviseren van klanten en collega's over slimme infrastructurele keuzes.   Na succesvolle oplevering draag je de omgeving over aan onze Hosting Engineers, die het dagelijkse beheer overnemen. Jij richt je vervolgens op het volgende project. Wie ben jij? We zoeken een ervaren professional met hbo werk- en denkniveau . Je voelt je thuis in Linux en Infrastructure as Code . Tools zoals Terraform en Ansible hebben voor jou geen geheimen: je bent echt een bouwer die zich als een vis in het water voelt bij deze technologieën. Je hebt ruime ervaring met het zelfstandig ontwerpen en migreren van complete IT-omgevingen. Je communiceert helder, pakt eigenaarschap en werkt gestructureerd. Verder woon je in Nederland en spreek je bij voorkeur Nederlands . Wat bieden wij jou? De Organisatie: Je versterkt een snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met een sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software. Autonomie: Je krijgt veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact: Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten met een directe en tastbare maatschappelijke impact. Salaris: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €7.500,- passend bij jouw ervaring. Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om goed uit te rusten en op te laden. Werkplek & Sfeer: Een gezellige werksfeer op ons kantoor in Hilversum met flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en elke dag een verzorgde lunch op kantoor. Mobiliteit & Fiets: Een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km of een volledige OV-vergoeding, én een fiscaal aantrekkelijk fietsplan. Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen voor jouw toekomst. jobs.title: Stage Consumentengedrag
jobs.description: Waarom pak je in de supermarkt het ene product wel uit het schap en het andere niet? Ligt het aan de verpakking? De prijs? Smaak? Gemak? Of simpelweg omdat het precies op de juiste plek staat? Bij Growy telen we verse sla, kruiden en microgreens in Amsterdam in onze vertical farm. Vertical farming klinkt misschien ingewikkeld, maar het idee is simpel: we telen planten in lagen boven elkaar, midden in de stad en helemaal los van het weer buiten. Nu onze producten in steeds meer Nederlandse supermarkten te vinden zijn, willen we onze consumenten nóg beter leren begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en commercieel ingestelde stagiair die zich wil verdiepen in consumentengedrag en inzichten kan vertalen naar echte commerciële kansen. En nee, dit wordt geen stageproject wat ergens in een lade verdwijnt en niemand ooit nog bekijkt, jouw stage gaat voor ons echt een verschil maken! 🌱 Wat ga je doen? Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat meer consumenten Growy ontdekken, proberen én opnieuw kopen? Tijdens je stage ga je bijvoorbeeld: consumenten interviewen en/of focusgroepen organiseren; onderzoeken wat mensen belangrijk vinden bij het kopen van verse salades en kruiden; ontdekken welke drempels consumenten ervan weerhouden een product te proberen; onderzoeken wat juist zorgt voor een herhaalaankoop; kijken naar kansen rondom prijs, assortiment, verpakking, positionering, promoties en zichtbaarheid; kwantitatief onderzoek, zoals enquêtes, opzetten om ideeën te testen; jouw inzichten vertalen naar concrete commerciële en marketingaanbevelingen. En als het binnen je stage past, kun je misschien zelfs één van je ideeën in de praktijk testen. De precieze inhoud stemmen we af op de duur van je stage en de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding. Goed om te weten; onze farm is nog volop in ontwikkeling, we zitten nog in onze start-up/scale-up fase. Dit betekent dat je naast je onderzoek ook tijd zult besteden aan andere zaken in onze farm. Dit geldt niet alleen voor jou als stagiair maar voor ons hele team. jobs.description: About us INCO is a leading social enterprise on a mission to shape a more inclusive and sustainable economy that creates opportunities for all. Our work spans five complementary activities: INCO Academy: skilling programs for people facing barriers to employment, leading to careers in fast-growing industries such as technology, sustainability and healthcare (400,000+ job seekers trained to date). INCO Kids: education and awareness programs giving school-age learners future-proof knowledge in technology, sustainability, citizenship and more (350,000+ learners supported to date). INCO Entrepreneurs: incubation and acceleration for underrepresented founders and social entrepreneurs (2,000+ businesses supported every year). INCO Ventures: impact investing and funding for social and environmental impact startups (€500M+ assets under management). INCO Spaces: co-working and co-living spaces for social and environmental innovators (Paris, Berlin, Warsaw and more). About the program: AI and the Future of Work is a new three-year research and policy-engagement program (2026–2029), funded through a research grant partnership and led end to end by INCO. It tracks AI's real-world impact on jobs, tasks and productivity across all 27 EU member states, and gives policymakers the evidence, trend baselines and scenario-planning tools to capture AI's productivity upside while managing the workforce transition. About the role: We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to run the AI and the Future of Work program day to day and make sure it delivers on time, on budget and to the grant's commitments. You will closely lead and collaborate with a Research Lead and a Policy Lead.  You will turn a three-year grant into a working operation: a deliverables calendar across 27 countries, a consortium of up to 15 partners, a publication schedule and a reporting cycle the funder can trust. You need to be comfortable working alongside researchers and policy specialists, and fluent in the rhythm of grant-funded research programs. Responsibilities: Lead program delivery end to end  Planning and implementation Build and own the three-year implementation plan: workstreams, milestones, dependencies and the deliverables calendar agreed with the funder. Run the program's operating rhythm: weekly core-team check-ins, monthly consortium updates and quarterly steering reviews. Coordinate the publication pipeline with the Research and Policy Leads: quarterly data refreshes, five semi-annual reports, policy briefs, the annual flagship and the 2029 EU27 report. Keep thorough program documentation: plans, decision logs, risk register and handover notes. jobs.title: Head of Content Marketing (m/w/d) – B2B Personal Branding

Das ist eine Senior-Rolle mit voller Verantwortung, direkt an der Seite der beiden Gründer. Vor 5,5 Jahren saßen wir zu zweit in einer WG in Düsseldorf. Kein Büro, kein Umsatz, keine Kunden. Nur ein Telefon. Heute sind wir 35 Leute auf knapp 900 m² Office. Rügamer & Steiner ist eine E-Mail- und CRM-Marketing-Agentur für E-Commerce: Wir helfen Onlineshops, mehr Umsatz aus ihren Bestandskunden zu holen – mit E-Mail-Marketing, WhatsApp, Printmailings und datengetriebenem CRM. Für über 150 Shops steuern wir so über 200 Mio. € Jahresumsatz mit. Unser eigener Umsatz liegt im mittleren einstelligen Millionenbereich und hat sich seit der Gründung jedes Jahr verdoppelt. Alles davon ist aus Telefonaten entstanden. Kein Marketing, keine Brand, kein Content. Erst haben wir selbst telefoniert, heute tut es ein 6-köpfiges Sales-Team, das gerade auf 10 wächst. Unser Haken: Uns kennt kein Mensch. Das ändern wir jetzt. Bis 2028 wollen wir 30 Mio. € Jahresumsatz machen und europäischer Marktführer werden in dem, was wir tun. Für unsere Kunden wollen wir jedes Jahr über 1 Mrd. € Umsatz bewegen. Dafür brauchen wir Sichtbarkeit. Und dafür brauchen wir dich. Das Material liegt bereit: eine echte Geschichte, Zahlen, Cases und zwei Gründer, die jedes Jahr über 300.000 € investieren, um von den Besten zu lernen – unter anderem in der höchsten Mastermind von Alex Hormozi. Deine Mission Du baust die Personal Brands von Noah Rügamer und Aurelian Steiner auf – zuerst auf LinkedIn, später Newsletter, YouTube und Podcast. Du entwickelst Positionierung, Content-Strategie, Formate, Hooks und Redaktionsplan – mit Fokus auf E-Commerce-Unternehmer, die mehr aus ihren Bestandskunden holen wollen. Du baust den Weg von Reichweite zu Umsatz: Post → Kommentar oder DM → Termin → Auftrag für unser Sales-Team. Du machst die Brands gleichzeitig zum Recruiting-Magneten für die besten Leute. Du arbeitest eng mit uns Gründern: Content-Tage, Interviews, Skripte. Dein Ziel ist, dass wir so wenig Zeit wie möglich brauchen. Daneben schärfst du den Marketing-Auftritt der Firma mit: Website, Ads, Bewerber-Kommunikation. Das ist der kleinere Teil. Was du mitbringen musst Du hast nachweislich eine B2B-Founder-Brand aufgebaut oder mit aufgebaut – deine eigene oder als Ghostwriter, Stratege oder Head of Content. Über diese Brand ist nachweislich Umsatz entstanden: mindestens 100.000 € im Monat, idealerweise 200.000 bis 300.000 €. Idealerweise kommst du aus dem B2B-Dienstleister- oder Agentur-Umfeld oder hast selbst eine Agentur über Personal Branding skaliert. Bonus: E-Commerce, Marketing oder SaaS. Fluent written and spoken German, with English sufficient for effective collaboration with global colleagues. jobs.title: Forward-Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: ZeitMind, the autonomous data engineer for the European mid-market About Zeit AI In the coming years, AI agents will take over the work of internal data teams. We’re building the one companies will use. ZeitMind connects to the systems companies already run (ERP, CRM, spreadsheets, internal databases), cleans messy data, runs analyses on its own and builds data applications. Every employee can work with data in plain language, with no technical degree and no help from IT. Our customers use it to organise agricultural inventories, to schedule maintenance, crews and flights for jet operators, and to replace controllers’ manual Excel reports. Founded by Marvin and Leopold, both ex-Palantir. YC S24, backed by Oxford Seed Fund and Sequoia Scout. Zero to €1M ARR in our first twelve months with six people. Your mission Forward Deployed Engineers find where real value is hidden in a company’s data and build the apps that unlock it. Half business, half tech: you’re as comfortable in front of a CEO as inside a dataset. What you’ll do Spend real time at customer sites, from the CFO’s office to the warehouse floor, and get to the core of an unfamiliar business fast Decide what’s worth building, and just as importantly, what isn’t Use ZeitMind to connect customer data, model business logic (margins, costs, stock, pricing) and ship operational apps within days Present to managing directors and owners, and take them from “interesting demo” to “we run on this every day” Own a portfolio of customers end to end, and shape our product and how we deploy it What we value You learn fast. New industry, new data, new terms: you get up to speed in no time. You bring structure. You break messy problems into clear parts and know where to start. You care about outcomes. You go after the root cause and the euro value, not the nice-looking analysis. You’re rigorous. You can explain exactly how a number came about. You make things happen. You don’t wait for a perfect brief. You take ownership and move. We hire across levels, from exceptional early-career talent to senior FDEs who’ve led complex client engagements. Backgrounds that fit well (none of these is a must) Consulting. You’ve led client work across industries and know how to win over a managing director. Software implementation or value engineering. You’ve rolled out software at customers and made sure it actually got used. Data analytics, BI or controlling. You’ve worked hands-on with real company data. Technical foundation. You’ve studied something quantitative or picked up SQL along the way, and you like knowing how things work under the hood. You don’t need to be a software engineer, but you should have a natural pull towards data and technology. ZeitMind does the heavy lifting. The basics English at C1 or above. German is a big plus, since many of our customers work in German. You’re excited to work in-person in Munich or London and at customer sites, at an early-stage startup pace. What we offer Real ownership from day one, full trust and maximum support Best tools, zero blockers Daily lunch allowance, dinner covered in the office, Wellpass Regular team offsites Relocation support within Europe €5k referral bonus if we hire someone you refer Interview process First call with Elena Decomposition interview ZeitMind take-home case Founder conversation with Leopold and lunch with the team References → offer We aim to get through this in two weeks. jobs.title: Operations Agent – Call Center & Kundenservice (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wer wir sind Wir sind ein innovatives PropTech-Team aus Bonn und kümmern uns um etwas, das in Deutschland noch erstaunlich analog ist: Wer eine Immobilie kauft, verkauft oder finanziert, braucht Unterlagen von Ämtern, zum Beispiel Grundbuchauszug, Bauakte oder Baulastenauskunft. Die liegen bei vielen hundert Behörden, und jede tickt anders. Manches geht digital, vieles nur per Telefon, Mail, Fax oder Post. DocEstate sorgt dafür, dass die Unterlagen vollständig und pünktlich ankommen. Digital, wo es geht. Mit Menschen, die dranbleiben, wo es nicht geht. Unsere Kunden sind vor allem Investoren, Wohnungsunternehmen, Hausverwaltungen und Kanzleien. Deine Aufgaben Behörden melden sich nicht immer von selbst. Du sorgst dafür, dass die Auskünfte trotzdem ankommen. Du rufst bei Ämtern an, fragst nach dem Stand einer Anfrage und findest heraus, wer wirklich zuständig ist. Du schreibst Nachfragen und Erinnerungen per Mail oder Fax, sachlich und so, dass sie bearbeitet werden. Du klärst Rückfragen und sorgst dafür, dass fehlende Angaben schnell nachgereicht werden. Du hältst jeden Kontakt in unserem System fest und behältst Fristen und offene Vorgänge im Blick. Du merkst, wo es im Ablauf immer wieder hakt, und bringst Ideen ein, wie es besser geht. Darüber hinaus sprichst du situativ auch direkt mit unseren Kunden, wenn es Rückfragen zu ihren Anfragen gibt. So sieht dein Alltag wirklich aus Viel Telefon: Behörden erreichst du am besten vormittags, etwa zwischen 8 und 12 Uhr. Das ist deine Zeit, unser Team mit deinen Skills nach vorne zu bringen. Rund um die Telefonzeit schreibst du Nachfragen, dokumentierst und bereitest die nächsten Anrufe vor, so wie du das für richtig hältst. Behörden sind nicht immer schnell. Manchmal wirst du zum dritten Mal vertröstet. Wer gern Dinge gründlich zu Ende bringt, ist hier richtig. Du bearbeitest viele Vorgänge parallel. Ordnung im Kopf und mit System sind wichtigste Werkzeuge für dich. Das bringst du mit Du hast Bock, anzupacken, und willst Dinge erledigt sehen, nicht nur verwaltet. Du drückst dich klar aus, am Telefon und schriftlich. Deine Mails können ohne aufwendige Nachbearbeitung rausgehen. Sicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1). Du bleibst freundlich, auch beim dritten Anruf zum selben Vorgang. Du arbeitest sorgfältig und behältst bei vielen parallelen Vorgängen den Überblick. Du kannst in den ersten ein bis zwei Monaten jeden Tag bei uns in Bonn sein, denn die Einarbeitung findet vor Ort statt. Von Vorteil, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung im Call Center oder Kundenservice, am liebsten Outbound, also aktiv nachfassen statt nur annehmen Erfahrung mit Behörden, Verwaltung, Kanzlei, Notariat oder Immobilienverwaltung Sicherer Umgang mit Ticket- oder CRM-Systemen Was wir dir bieten Unbefristeter Vertrag, Start ab sofort Strukturierte Einarbeitung: ein bis zwei Monate vor allem vor Ort, mit festen Ansprechpartnern Danach hybrid: 2 Tage im Büro, 3 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche Büro im Digital Hub direkt am Bonner Hauptbahnhof, gut mit Bus und Bahn erreichbar Ein Team, das offen sagt, was gut läuft und was nicht, und deine Ideen ernst nimmt So läuft deine Bewerbung Kein Anschreiben nötig. Dein Lebenslauf reicht, gern mit zwei, drei Sätzen dazu, warum die Stelle zu dir passt. Kurzes Telefonat (ca. 15 Minuten) Kennenlernen bei uns in Bonn mit kleinem Dive-In aus dem echten Arbeitsalltag Du hörst innerhalb von 5 Werktagen von uns. Du erkennst dich hier wieder, hast aber nicht jeden Punkt abgehakt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns ist wichtiger, wie du am Telefon und im Schriftverkehr auftrittst, als welche Stationen im Lebenslauf stehen. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Technischer Projektleiter Robotik & Physical AI (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft von Physical AI und Robotik! Ihre Verantwortung reicht von der Anforderungsaufnahme über Architektur und Integration bis zur Inbetriebnahme, zum Benchmarking und zur Validierung. Ein zentraler Fokus liegt auf Physical AI: Sie evaluieren und vergleichen aktuelle Foundation Models und Physical-AI-Modelle in verschiedenen Use-Case-Szenarien. Sie bereiten Modelle für konkrete industrielle Use Cases vor, passen sie durch anwendungsspezifisches Training/Fine-Tuning an und validieren ihre Leistungsfähigkeit in realen Robotik-Umgebungen. Ihre Aufgaben Aufbau, Integration und Betrieb der technischen Infrastruktur für Datenerfassung, Modelltraining, Simulation und die Umsetzung realer Use Cases mit Robotik- und Physical-AI-Systemen. Gemeinsame Ausgestaltung industrieller Use Cases mit Industriepartnern zur Erprobung mobiler und humanoider Roboter. Evaluation, Vergleich, Integration und Anpassung von Physical-AI-Modellen und Foundation Models für unterschiedliche Robotik-Hardwaresysteme. Durchführung von Machbarkeitsstudien, Benchmarks, Pilotprojekten und Validierungen unter industrienahen Bedingungen. Aufbau von Trainingsworkflows für das Erlernen von Bewegungsabläufen durch verschiedene humanoide Robotiksysteme. Die Workflows umfassen reale Datenerfassung/Data-Capturing-Pipelines (z.B. mittels Teleoperationssystemen), Simulation, Datenaugmentation, Modelltraining sowie die Übertragung auf physische Robotik-Hardware. Technische Leitung und Durchführung von Industrieprojekten im Hub gemeinsam mit dem technischen Team in Stuttgart und Aachen. Planung und Steuerung sprintorientierter Arbeitspakete entlang der gesamten Software- und Hardware-Toolchain. Koordination interner Teams, externer Technologiepartner und industrieller Kunden. Entwicklung der technischen Roadmap sowie Identifikation neuer Technologien, Partner und Anwendungsfelder. Beratung von Industriepartnern sowie industriellen Kunden bei der technischen Vorbereitung, Umsetzung und Bewertung ihrer Robotik- und Physical-AI-Use-Cases. Ihr Profil Abgeschlossenes Diplom- oder Masterstudium in Robotik, Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Maschinenbau, Automatisierungstechnik, Künstlicher Intelligenz oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. This is a new role, the first dedicated media relations seat at Mews, so the contacts you build and the way you work will set the standard for how we deal with the press. Mews has strong stories and data to offer, and this role exists so that someone owns that conversation: choosing the right journalist for each story, answering inbound questions quickly and accurately, and knowing when to escalate something sensitive. Done well, it builds the company's reputation with the people who cover our industry over the long term.</p> <h4>What you would do</h4> <ul> <li>Build and maintain direct relationships with journalists across hospitality, travel, technology and business media: develop stories with the communications team, pitch them proactively by phone and email, host press briefings and invite journalists to events such as Unfold.</li> <li>Respond to inbound press enquiries (currently two to three a week and growing) quickly and accurately, and escalate anything potentially sensitive to the communications lead straight away.</li> <li>Brief and coach executive and local spokespeople, and share what you learn from journalists with leadership.</li> <li>Redesign how media monitoring, journalist research and coverage reporting work using AI, and set the workflows up so the rest of the team can use them.</li> <li>Own and improve the team's media management tool, and check every AI-assisted pitch, briefing or summary before it reaches a journalist.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Fluency Level 3:</strong> in this role that means you have gone well beyond using AI to draft copy. HAIL (HRT AI Labs) is the team at HRT responsible for developing and maintaining our most powerful models, which are used by our trading teams to drive a significant fraction of our trading. We are building and deploying "foundation models for markets", that ingest and train on vast amounts of market and “alternative” data (such as language) to make predictions about future market state.</p> <p>As a research engineer on HAIL, you will have a general mandate to improve all aspects of large-scale model training, including but not limited to kernel development, training data loading, parallelism, networking, and fault-tolerance. jobs.description: gravity9 is recruiting Java engineers and architects for a portfolio of engagements across UK central government. We are hiring across two overlapping profiles — Senior Java Developer and Application / Migration Architect — and expect most people to move between programmes as engagements start and complete. Legacy-to-document-model migration at national scale Migrating hundreds of millions of records and tens of terabytes of XML out of a legacy relational platform into a sharded document store, in support of a COBOL-to-Java microservices rewrite. The work includes a configuration-driven XML-to-JSON transformation framework backed by a versioned schema registry — twenty years of history, multiple record types and continual schema and semantic drift; CDC and streaming pipelines, or a checkpointed parallel bulk-extract alternative; a field-level mapping validation and reconciliation framework robust enough to stand up to audit; a replay and failure-diagnostics harness with dead-letter routing and idempotent re-runs; and repeated dress rehearsals toward a single cutover window with no dual running. Monolith decomposition and data-ownership migration Breaking a distributed monolith of well over a hundred Java services sharing a handful of database clusters into domain-owned services — moving from borrowed data to owned data without reintroducing hidden coupling. The work includes bounded-context analysis to establish which domain genuinely owns which collections, in-place data remodelling ahead of any physical move, a data-access facade with feature-flagged per-request routing between old and new stores, dual-write / backfill / reconcile / read-switch cutover lifecycles with a defined rollback at every step, cluster-to-cluster streaming and live migration tooling, and automated parallel-run and diff-on-read testing. This role is for you if… you've designed the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems and know your way around creepage, clearance and insulating plastics. You back your designs with solid calculations, and you're as comfortable with a screwdriver in the workshop as with CAD at your desk. This role isn't for you if… your experience is in classic mechanical design only, such as gears, gearboxes or pumps, or you prefer to stay at your desk while someone else builds your prototypes. Model and design electro-mechanical parts and assemblies, including plastics, sheet metal, insulation systems, magnetic components and cooling system interfaces. Ensure electrical safety through the design on both the medium-voltage and low-voltage side: creepage and clearance distances, CTI and material selection, electrical isolation and sealing. Solid knowledge of creepage, clearance, CTI, insulation coordination and electrical safety (e.g. IEC 60664-1, IEC 62477-1), ideally up to medium voltage.
