jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Partner Integrations
jobs.description: About the team Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives. Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment. The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control. You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with your engineering manager, the product manager, a growing team, and experienced engineers across the broader org. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk. What you'll do You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. The patterns you set there become defaults the rest of the team builds on. Day to day, that looks like: Owning the architecture: auth and identity flows, multi-tenancy, how data moves and where it's allowed to live, performance, and what happens in production Running what you build. Which means owning the infrastructure, CI, deployment, observability behind it and on-call Working on top of external platforms you can't change, and being straight about which risks are yours to manage and which aren't Partnering closely with the internal teams whose services you depend on: iterating on product requirements, agreeing on interfaces and protocols, and proactively finding ways to keep moving About you These are the attributes of someone who will perform well in this role: 8+ years building software, with a good chunk of it on data-heavy or integration-flavored systems Preferably proficient in TypeScript or Go or comfortable contributing to each Solid backend and systems instincts. You can reason about deployment topology, multi-tenancy, and data movement, and you're comfortable owning architectural tradeoffs you'll have to live with later You've worked with modern auth protocols, service principals, and identity federation, and you know how to get it right across a trust boundary You've built on someone else's platform and know what that's actually like: incomplete docs, unintended breaking changes, etc. You're comfortable in ambiguity. You can ship before the spec is finished, make sensible calls under uncertainty, and flag the decisions that'll be hard to undo to your team before we bake them in. You're good with other engineers. Much of the work runs through teams you don't own, and you earn their trust by how you think, not just what you commit. You're mainly a backend engineer, but you're comfortable enough to touch a modern React app You use AI tools well and honestly. Reach for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or whatever helps, and be clear about where you did and didn't You write well. Most of how we coordinate happens async in chats, design docs and RFCs Nice to have None of these are required, but any of them would be a bonus: Close familiarity with a major cloud data or analytics platform ecosystem Real depth in auth and identity federation, or experience building to a partner's security review, marketplace requirements or ce

jobs.title: Cloud Architect
jobs.description: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.   By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.   At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. We are looking for a Cloud Architect to shape and implement Vitestro's cloud platform with a clear, pragmatic technical direction. Our infrastructure runs on AWS and supports mission-critical, regulated medical device software. Vitestro is also realizing its first integration with Laboratory Information System (LIS) over the cloud, and delivering that connection is a core part of this role. We need someone who translates real operational and business constraints into working systems — someone whose first instinct is "what does this actually need to do, reliably and affordably," not "what's the most sophisticated way to solve this." You will join the Platform & Connectivity team and build alongside its cloud, backend, and DevOps engineers. This is an individual-contributor technical leadership role, not a people-management position — you carry the architectural vision and build it hands-on with the team, rather than designing something for others to execute. If you'd rather ship a solid, working solution than iterate endlessly toward a theoretically ideal one, and you have a track record of keeping cloud costs under control at scale, you'll thrive in this role. First months at Vitestro In your first months, you get to know our cloud platform, the device connectivity and the team. You review the current architecture, its costs and its production-readiness, and identify where the biggest risks and quick wins are. You take ownership of the cloud architecture for our first LIS integration, and you agree with the team on the first architectural standards for observability, logging and infrastructure as code. This is what success looks like: After 12 months, our first LIS integration runs reliably in production, with monitoring, alerting and failure handling in place. Cloud costs are predictable and under control, and key architectural decisions and trade-offs are recorded. The team uses shared patterns instead of reinventing solutions, and is confident running production systems as we move from pre-market to post-market. Key Responsibilities: Set the technical direction for our AWS-based cloud platform and build it hands-on with the team — weighing cost, operability, and production-readiness as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts Own the cloud architecture of Vitestro's first LIS integration over the cloud: secure, reliable, and traceable data exchange between our platform and the hospital laboratory Choose solutions on their merits rather than defaulting to the most AWS-native option — including other clouds, self-hosted tooling, or dedicated infrastructure when that's genuinely the better fit Take implementations from a working prototype to something that's production-ready — monitoring, alerting, and failure handling included. You bring experience with production systems and advise the team on how to navigate from pre-market to post-market stages. jobs.description: At TechBiz Global, we are providing recruitment service to our TOP clients from our portfolio. We are currently seeking a Director, Fintech Partnerships & Strategic Programmes (Europe) to join one of our clients ' teams. If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to grow in a innovative environment, this could be the perfect fit for you. What you will do 1. Fintech business development Build and own the European pipeline across leasing and asset-finance houses, banks, neobanks, BNPL and instalment providers, Device-as-a-Service and subscription platforms, and embedded-finance players. Design new propositions with partners, such as end-of-lease value recovery, guaranteed residual value, trade-in-linked upgrade credit and recommerce for financed devices. Lead deals from first conversation to signature: pitch, solution design, commercial modelling, term sheets and contract negotiation with Legal. Grow revenue from signed partners by expanding into new countries, device categories and products. Represent NorthLadder at fintech, leasing and circular-economy forums and build our profile in the ecosystem. 2. Large-scale programme leadership Own our flagship enterprise end-of-lease programme end to end, from pilot go-live to a scaled, multi-partner, multi-country operation. Orchestrate a complex ecosystem: brand partner, funders, lessors, processing facility, logistics partners, buyers, and NorthLadder Ops, Product, Tech, Finance and Legal. Run programme governance at executive level: roadmap, milestones, RAID, steering committees, monthly and quarterly business reviews. Own the money flows: bidding, title transfer, invoicing, buyer collection, partner settlement and reconciliation, with Finance. Set and hold the KPIs that matter: recovery value, turnaround time, grading accuracy, settlement timelines and programme P&L. Turn the flagship into a repeatable playbook we can roll out to every new financial partner. 10+ years of experience, with a strong track record in a new-age fintech: leasing or asset-finance tech, Device-as-a-Service, BNPL, embedded finance, payments or neobanking. A proven business developer who has opened and closed partnerships with banks, lessors, funders or large technology brands. A programme leader who has delivered large, cross-border, multi-stakeholder programmes from launch to scale, not just managed a project plan. Fluent in the economics of financed assets: lease lifecycles, residual value, title transfer, settlement and reconciliation. Commercially sharp: builds unit-economics models, negotiates fee structures and reads a P&L. Comfortable in a scale-up: hands-on, data-driven, product-minded and quick to turn ambiguity into a working process. Familiar with GDPR and the compliance expectations of regulated financial partners. Based in the Netherlands with the right to work in the EU, and happy to travel across Europe and the UK. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Customs
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.&nbsp;</p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>Why Customs Matters More Than Ever</strong></h3> <p>International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis — sparked by Trump-era tariffs — has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.</p> <p>That’s where we come in. The <strong>Customs Technology team</strong> at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing.</p> <h3><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h3> <p>Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough.</p> <p>Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. Being a tech company, we can move much faster than our competitors, and give our customers the service they expect in this day and age. We can deploy things like LLM agents at scale, in an industry that is ripe to be disrupted by this technology.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <p>As an Engineering Manager in the Customs Technology team, you’ll lead a group of exceptional engineers to:</p> <ul> <li>Build world class tools like our Tariff Simulator, the only tool that gives businesses a real view of landed costs before they ship.</li> <li>Automate customs processes to an unprecedented level. Most customs are text based work, which is what agents excel at.&nbsp;</li> <li>Design scalable systems that automate classification, compliance, and filings—turning weeks of work into seconds.</li> <li>Partner with product, design, and operations to deliver technology that gives clients clarity, cost savings, and risk control.</li> <li>Mentor and grow a world-class 8-10 member engineering team that thrives on solving the hardest problems in logistics.</li> <li>Shape the future of customs into a transparent, efficient, and strategic advantage for businesses worldwide.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Things We ❤️</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leveraging AI in a safe way to eliminate mundane work for customs brokers and automate customs every step of the way</li> <li>Modeling complex and ambiguous domains into fully automated workflows</li> <li>Building highly performant and reliable Kotlin services on our cutting-edge infrastructure platform</li> <

jobs.description: The challenge An entrepreneur chasing an unpaid invoice in Lagos. A shop owner confirming a shipment in Guangzhou. A consultant navigating a bank's phone menu in London. For a growing share of Talk360's 6 million+ users, a call is how they get paid, keep a client or close a deal. These business customers choose us because we're cheaper than carrier and roaming rates, reach mobile, landline and company numbers, need no contract, and use one balance for every country. Today we serve them with a consumer app. Tomorrow we want to be the obvious way small businesses call the world. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and scale the Calling for Work product proposition from 1 to 100. There's no mature roadmap to inherit: you'll write it, test it with customers and scale what works, with our Product & Tech team, to deliver a step change in segment growth. What you’ll do Own the product proposition: Set the vision, strategy, roadmap and targets for Calling for Work, and be responsible for its user growth and retention. Shape the business proposition: Define what Talk360's business offer is and how it's priced, together with our commercial teams. Learn from customers continuously: Use interviews, surveys, support tickets and app store reviews to turn pains into a ranked opportunity roadmap. Experiment fast: Ship small bets, A/B test the journeys that matter, observe real world behaviour and turn results into roadmap decisions. Lead delivery: Work in an agile Product & Tech team; keep scope tight, priorities clear and releases flowing. AI-native execution: Use AI across discovery, specs, analysis and prototyping, and help shape how the team builds with AI. Partner across the business: Work with Revenue, Marketing, Support and Data on go-to-market, acquisition, retention and the metrics that show we're winning. The Team You'll join a lean Product & Engineering team where product, design, mobile, web, backend, VoIP and QA work closely together. No silos, no layers: turn a customer insight on Monday into a live experiment by Friday. What you’ll bring 5+ years in product management, including owning a product line or new proposition end to end. A track record of scaling a product from early traction, with commercial results to show. Hands-on experience with B2B, SMB or prosumer products; telecoms is a plus. Strong discovery skills: customer interviews, research synthesis and jobs-to-be-done thinking. Experimentation fluency: A/B testing, product analytics (Mixpanel or similar) and data analysis and data-driven decision making. Experience optimising MAU, ARPU, LTV, retention and conversion, with the business acumen to make strategic and tactical calls. Experience leading agile, cross-functional mobile product teams, with the technical depth to discuss trade-offs with engineers. Active, daily use of AI across your product workflow: research, analysis, specs and prototyping. Who you are Growth mindset: You're energised by building a playbook that doesn't exist yet. jobs.title: Recruiter – Quereinstieg aus Vertrieb & Marketing (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du willst Menschen gewinnen. Und an Ergebnissen gemessen werden. Für uns hat Recruiting dieselbe Energie wie guter Vertrieb: Chancen erkennen, eine überzeugende Ansprache entwickeln, viel umsetzen und konsequent am Ball bleiben. Du planst und drehst Recruiting-Ads und Content. Du knüpfst Kontakte, entwickelst dein Netzwerk und gehst im Active Sourcing auf interessante Menschen zu. Du testest neue Ansätze, führst Gespräche und hältst die nächsten Schritte verbindlich nach. Was dich antreibt: Verantwortung, eine hohe eigene Schlagzahl und sichtbare Ergebnisse. Klare Ziele geben dir Orientierung. Leistungsabhängige Vergütung motiviert dich. Du willst selbst beeinflussen, was du erreichst. So gewinnst du die richtigen Menschen für unser Team Bei Rügamer & Steiner rekrutierst du für unser eigenes Unternehmen – von Sales über Projekt- und Accountmanagement bis zu Content und AI/Tech. Dafür verbindest du mehrere Wege: Recruiting-Ads: Du entwickelst Botschaften und Videoideen für unsere Stellen und planst die Aufnahmen gemeinsam mit uns. Vor der Kamera stehen unter anderem Aurelian, Simeon und Noah – gelegentlich auch du selbst. Content: Du planst und drehst Inhalte, die unsere Arbeit, unser Team und die beruflichen Möglichkeiten bei uns sichtbar machen. Netzwerk: Du baust aktiv Beziehungen auf, erschließt Empfehlungen und bringst interessante Menschen zusammen. Zum Beispiel organisierst du ein monatliches Abendessen mit Account-Managern aus Düsseldorf: zum Kennenlernen, für fachlichen Austausch und um langfristig Kontakte zu Menschen aufzubauen, die unser Team verstärken könnten. Active Sourcing: Du findest passende Kandidaten und sprichst sie persönlich an – über LinkedIn, Nachrichten und Telefon. Gespräche und Nachhalten: Du klärst Erfahrung, Motivation und Erwartungen, hältst Kontakt und bringst gemeinsam mit den Teamleads der einzelnen Abteilungen die nächsten Schritte bis zur Entscheidung voran. Du schaust dir an, welche Ansprache funktioniert, welche Inhalte Interesse wecken und über welche Wege passende Menschen kommen. Daraus entwickelst du die nächsten Maßnahmen. Du verantwortest, dass aus deinen Aktivitäten gute Gespräche und erfolgreiche Besetzungen entstehen. Das bringst du mit Du hast bereits Menschen gewonnen und Stellen besetzt – in einer Personalberatung, im Inhouse-Recruiting oder für dein eigenes Unternehmen. Oder du kommst aus Vertrieb oder Marketing und willst deine Erfahrung jetzt im Recruiting einsetzen. Du weißt, wie man Zielgruppen versteht, Interesse weckt, überzeugende Gespräche führt und aus ersten Kontakten konkrete Ergebnisse entwickelt. Entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen gewinnen kannst, eigenständig ins Handeln kommst und bereit bist, dir das Recruiting-Handwerk anzueignen. Zeig uns anhand konkreter Beispiele, was du selbst vorangebracht und erreicht hast. Du kommunizierst überzeugend auf Deutsch und Englisch, organisierst mehrere Suchen gleichzeitig und hältst Zusagen zuverlässig nach. Du hast Lust, sichtbar zu werden, Ideen auszuprobieren und dich an Ergebnissen messen zu lassen. Das erwartet dich bei uns Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und den Verantwortlichen unserer Fachbereiche zusammen. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss darauf, mit welchen Menschen wir unser Unternehmen weiter aufbauen. Du gestaltest unsere Ansprache mit, entwickelst neue Wege der Kandidatengewinnung und übernimmst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung. Klassische HR-Verwaltung gehört nicht zu deiner Rolle. Bei Kampagnentechnik und Videoschnitt arbeitest du mit den jeweils Zuständigen zusammen. Dein Arbeitsort ist unser Büro in Düsseldorf. Wir bieten eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 26 Urlaubstagen. Leistung soll sich für dich lohnen Unser Ziel ist, dass du bei uns 100.000 € und mehr im Jahr verdienen kannst. Für die Position sehen wir eine Gesamtvergütung von 6.000–12.000 € brutto im Monat inklusive variablem Anteil vor. Wir suchen jemanden, den klare Ziele, Verantwortung und leistungsabhä

jobs.title: Head of Operations (m/w/d) · 11 Gameshow-Filialen · Remote mit Reisen
jobs.description: Vollzeit · Festanstellung · Start sofort · Firmenwagen · Berichtet an den Gründer Du führst 80+ Werkstudenten in 11 Filialen in ganz Deutschland. Filialleiter gibt es nicht. Du arbeitest von zu Hause, bist jede Woche in einer Filiale und greifst, wenn nötig, auch am Wochenende ein. Gamer - Die Gameshow Bei uns wird ein Ausflug mit Freunden oder Kollegen zur Gameshow. Aus über 20.000 Google Bewertungen haben wir 4,9 Sterne. 2027 wachsen wir weiter stark mit vielen neuen Filialen. Spiele, Technik und Software sind unsere Stärke. Der Betrieb unserer Filialen ist es bisher nicht. Trotz guter Bewertungen zeigt das Feedback unserer Gäste, dass es vor Ort zu oft hakt, z. B. bei der Sauberkeit und beim Wohlfühlen. Uns fehlt die Erfahrung, Strukturen und Abläufe so aufzubauen, dass sie auch funktionieren, wenn niemand von uns da ist. Diese Erfahrung bringst du mit. Deine Aufgabe Der Betrieb unserer 11 eigenen Filialen liegt bei dir: Teams, Abläufe und alles, was nötig ist, um Gäste vor Ort glücklich zu machen. Du führst die mehr als 80 Werkstudenten: von der Auswahl über das Training bis zum Abschied. Du baust die Strukturen auf, die heute fehlen. Welche das sind, findest du selbst heraus. Du bringst neue Filialen operativ an den Start. Du startest nicht allein: In deinem Team ist ein starker Operations Manager, der unsere Filialen und Werkstudenten sehr gut kennt. Die Richtung stimmst du direkt mit unserem Gründer ab. Daran merken wir, dass es klappt Gäste loben die Filiale, statt sie zu bemängeln. Auch an einem vollen Samstag. Die Teams arbeiten auch dann nach Standard, wenn niemand zuschaut. Gute Werkstudenten bleiben und werben andere an. Der NPS in jeder Filiale steigt deutlich, die Personalkosten dagegen steigen nicht. Der schwierigste Teil 11 Filialen, ein Besuch pro Woche: Jede Filiale siehst du nur einmal im Quartal. Dazwischen führst du über Systeme, Telefon und das Feedback der Gäste, das du in Echtzeit siehst. Standards zu entwickeln ist der leichte Teil. Der schwierige ist, dass sie auch ohne dich gelten. Wie wir arbeiten Remote-First ohne Headquarter. Wir schreiben lieber, als zu telefonieren. Entscheidungen fallen in Minuten per Chat, nicht in einem Meeting. Kein Ego. Kein Bullshit. Wir kommunizieren immer direkt und ehrlich. Leistung zählt mehr als jeder Titel. Wir arbeiten wie ein erfolgreiches Sport-Team. Nur wer Vollgas für unseren Erfolg gibt, ist Teil des Teams. Fehler sind komplett okay, jeder aber bitte nur einmal. Technik vor Personal: Was eine Software erledigen kann, soll kein Mensch machen. Was du mitbringst Du führst über die Auswahl der richtigen Leute, gutes Training, klare Erwartungen und konsequente Kontrolle, nicht über Angst. Du packst mit an. Siehst du vor Ort ein Problem, bist du ein Teil der Lösung. Danach sorgst du dafür, dass es nicht wiederkommt. Die Klimaanlage fällt aus und zwei Mitarbeiter sind krank: Das gibt dir Energie, weil etwas los ist. Auch beim zwanzigsten Mal noch. Unsere wichtigsten Tage sind das Wochenende. Auch dann fühlst du dich verantwortlich. Es zählt nicht, wie viele Stunden du arbeitest, sondern dass die Filialen laufen. Du weißt aus Erfahrung, wie Strukturen und Abläufe funktionieren, die auch ohne dich laufen. Ob du sie selbst aufgebaut oder übernommen hast, ist zweitrangig. Ob Hotellerie, Gastro oder Retail: Aus welcher Branche du kommst, ist egal. Dein Wille, hart für Erfolg zu arbeiten, ist es nicht. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und gut Englisch. Was wir bieten Das Gegenteil zum Konzern: schnelle Entscheidungen und viel Raum zur Gestaltung. Wir bauen, statt nur zu verwalten. Wir investieren sofort in gute Ideen. Ein neues Feature in der Software? Ist in wenigen Tagen da. Ein gutes Gehalt, dazu ein Bonus, der vom Feedback der Gäste abhängt (NPS). Firmenwagen. Und natürlich alle Reisekosten. jobs.title: Platform QA Chapter Lead (all genders)
jobs.description: As Platform QA Chapter Lead on the Platform side at JustPlay, you’ll lead and scale quality assurance for our core app experience - the foundation that powers our games, live operations, and player rewards. Working closely with Engineering, you’ll ensure the platform runs seamlessly across devices, regions, and releases, setting the standard for quality, reliability, and user experience. You'll split your time between hands-on QA work and leading the QA engineers in the QA chapter: helping them grow in their craft, spreading good practice, and raising the bar for quality across the teams you work with. A key part of this role will be driving smarter, more scalable testing approaches, including AI-driven testing and automation. Job Responsibilities Own the full QA lifecycle for JustPlay’s app and platform features - from test planning and execution to reporting and defect management. Foster a strong quality culture across teams by embedding QA best practices early and tying quality goals to product velocity and platform reliability. Drive innovation through AI-driven testing and predictive approaches to identify risks earlier, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort. Partner with development, design, and product teams to integrate QA best practices early in the release cycle. Design and maintain comprehensive test plans and automated suites for key user flows (login, payments, live events, notifications, etc.). Lead, mentor, and scale the QA team - setting up clear processes, code quality standards, and testing frameworks. Implement automation and regression testing strategies using tools such as Maestro, Espresso, XCTest, Appium, or similar frameworks. Use contract testing (e.g., Pact) to validate backend and service integrations. Apply performance and reliability testing across mobile platforms to ensure smooth user experiences. Job Requirements 5+ years of experience in QA for mobile apps or platforms, including at least 2 years leading teams. Proven ability to design scalable QA processes in fast-paced, development-heavy environments. Strong experience with automation frameworks, regression testing, and CI/CD pipelines. Hands-on experience with mobile debugging tools (Android Studio, Xcode) and network analysis tools like Charles. Strong understanding of how to build a quality-first mindset across engineering and product teams. Interest in or experience with AI-assisted testing and new QA technologies. Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a user-first mindset. Familiarity with project and documentation tools such as Jira and Notion. Nice to have Experience in backend integration testing and API monitoring. Experience with contract testing frameworks such as Pact. jobs.title: Inside Sales Manager
jobs.description: Inside Sales Manager (m/w/d) – Nachunternehmer Du hast Biss, Hunger auf Erfolg und willst Deals closen, statt nur über Leads zu reden? Dann ist das hier dein Spielfeld. Cosuno ist die größte Plattform, auf der Auftraggeber im Bau ihre Projekte ausschreiben und Handwerksbetriebe neue Aufträge finden. Der Nachunternehmer-Bereich ist unser am schnellsten wachsender Bereich, und 2027 wollen wir den Umsatz verdoppeln. Dafür suchen wir Closer, keine Verwalter. Deine Aufgaben Full Cycle: vom ersten Call über die Demo bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag Warme Leads statt Kaltakquise: Du rufst Handwerksbetriebe an, die bereits auf Cosuno registriert sind. Direkt mit Entscheidern: Am Telefon hast du Inhaber und Geschäftsführer, keine Einkaufsabteilungen. Das heißt kurze Entscheidungswege und schnelle Abschlüsse. Demos & Verhandlung: Du zeigst Betrieben, welche Aufträge auf sie warten, und bringst den Deal über die Ziellinie. Pipeline: Du hältst deine Opportunities in Salesforce sauber und auf Closing-Kurs. Dein Setup Jeden Morgen schlägt dir die KI deine besten Leads vor. Nach der Demo erstellt die KI eine persönliche Potenzialanalyse für deinen Kunden. Was kein Gespräch ist, automatisieren wir laufend. Deine Zeit steckst du in Calls, Demos und Abschlüsse. Was dich schneller macht, bauen wir mit dir ein. Deine Ideen zählen. Woran wir dich messen Umsatz gegen dein Monatsziel – das ist die Zahl, die zählt. Aktivität und Qualität: Calls, Demos, Conversion Entwicklung: wie schnell du Feedback umsetzt und dich anpasst Team: was du teilst und wie du andere besser machst Das alles siehst du transparent im täglichen Team-Ranking. Dein Profil Mindestens 2 Jahre Vertrieb, idealerweise B2B und Full Cycle Du kannst belegen, dass du deine Ziele konstant übertriffst, also über 100 %. Closing-Mindset: Für dich zählt der Abschluss, nicht der Prozess. Du überzeugst am Telefon, per Mail und in der Demo. Du nutzt AI-Tools selbstverständlich, verstehst Prozesse und hast Lust, sie mit zu automatisieren. Du lernst schnell, nimmst Feedback an und willst jeden Monat besser werden. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C2); Englisch ist ein Plus. Was wir bieten Fixum plus ungedeckelte Provision, jeden Monat ausgezahlt (optional: sechsstellig bei Zielerreichung) Ein klarer Karrierepfad: vom Inside Sales Manager über Senior bis zum Account Executive oder Teamlead, mit Fast Track für Overperformer Onboarding und Coaching durch die Top-Performer im Team Ein ambitioniertes Team in einem Markt, der gerade erst digital wird Warum wir? Gestalte ein Produkt mit echtem Impact: Wir lösen reale Probleme in einer der größten Industrien Europas – der Bauwirtschaft. Performance-Kultur: Ungedeckelte Provision, transparente Regeln und 100 % Eigenverantwortung für deinen Erfolg. Flexibilität: Arbeite remote oder in unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain. Team-Spirit: Internationales, dynamisches Team mit flachen Hierarchien und echtem Zusammenhalt. Wachstum: Regelmäßiges Feedback, 1:1s und Entwicklungsgespräche – wir wollen, dass du dich weiterentwickelst. Erfolge feiern: Ob Firmenevents oder Teamevents – wir gewinnen und feiern gemeinsam. About us Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology. We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity. Why Cosuno? Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs. But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different

jobs.title: Automation Engineer - Facilities SCADA & PLC (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Role We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to take technical ownership of the Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) that keeps our fab running - the system that supervises every utility our production depends on, from cleanroom air and chilled water to process cooling, exhaust and power monitoring. The system is delivered and commissioned by an external integrator; from handover, it's yours. You won't be building it from scratch - you'll be the person who understands it well enough to keep it running, diagnose it when it misbehaves, extend it as we grow from pilot line to full production, and hold suppliers to account. If the FMCS has an issue at 03:00, you're the one who knows what to do. To join our team, you should be excited to: Operate, monitor and maintain our SCADA system (Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum) across servers, operator stations and displays Maintain and diagnose our Siemens S7-1500 PLCs and their remote I/O, and adapt control logic within the existing standardised structure Plan and perform loop checks end to end - tracing each signal from the field device through wiring, I/O and PLC all the way to the operator screen, and confirming that commands actually move valves, dampers and actuators Investigate and resolve alarms, communication faults and unexpected equipment behaviourduring live operation Verify instrument calibration and troubleshoot analog and digital field signals - multimeter in hand, not only from a screen Add new datapoints, screens, trends and reports, and tune alarms so operators trust the system Keep documentation current - as-built drawings, tag lists, change records - and uphold change control Act as the technical counterpart to contractors and vendors, and support qualification and audits with system evidence Your Qualifications One of two equivalent qualification paths: a completed apprenticeship as an Electronics Technician for Automation Technology plus further training as a state-certified technician (Techniker), or comparable - or a degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering or a related field, or comparable 5+ years of hands-on experience with industrial SCADA and PLC systems in a production environment - commissioning, operating or supporting, not only design Solid experience with Siemens S7 PLCs (TIA Portal / Step 7) - going online, reading and modifying logic, diagnosing faults on a running plant; experience with comparable PLC platforms is also welcome Strong SCADA engineering skills - ideally Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum, but experience with another platform (e.g. WinCC, PCS 7, Ignition, Aveva, Zenon) plus the willingness to grow into WinCC OA is just as welcome Practical experience with loop checks, instrument calibration and signal troubleshooting, and with reading P&IDs, loop diagrams and I/O lists A structured, disciplined approach to documentation and change control, and the confidence to say no to a change that compromises safety or system integrity Good command of English; German is a strong advantage given the site, suppliers and local contractors Our work culture People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Kenntnisse in Social-Intelligence-Tools wie Tubular oder Locowise . jobs.title: Marketing Generalist
jobs.description: Company Neuphonic is building the future of on-device voice AI. We develop ultra-low-latency neural text-to-speech systems that enable super-realistic, human-like speech directly on devices. Our focus is on building efficient generative audio models and infrastructure that can run on CPU-constrained hardware, enabling real-time voice interaction without relying on large cloud infrastructure. By dramatically reducing latency and compute requirements, we are making natural conversational AI possible on phones, embedded devices, browsers, and edge systems. This requires building high-performance systems that bridge machine learning, real-time audio processing, and distributed infrastructure. Neuphonic was founded in April 2024 and is backed by leading B2B venture capital firms in Europe. Our customers include OEM handset manufacturers, chip manufacturers, and consumer AI companies building the next generation of voice-enabled products. Our vision is a world where voice becomes the most natural interface for AI, enabling seamless, intuitive interactions that are accessible to everyone. We’re solving challenging problems across real-time machine learning, edge inference, streaming systems, and ultra-low-latency infrastructure. If you enjoy working in a fast-moving environment and turning technical ideas into something people want to talk about, you’ll feel at home here. Role We’re looking for a Marketing Generalist to help build Neuphonic’s brand and grow awareness of our technology. This is a hands-on role for someone who is excited about AI, startups and technology, and wants to work across a broad range of marketing activities. You’ll work closely with the founders and wider team to help turn what we are building into interesting content, campaigns and moments that get people talking about Neuphonic. We’re looking for someone who is proactive, creative and highly organised. You don’t need to come in with a fully formed marketing playbook. What matters more is that you are curious, move quickly and are happy to take an idea and make it happen. Your work will include: Creating and publishing content across LinkedIn, X, our website and other relevant channels Helping plan and execute product launches, open-source releases and company announcements Turning technical work from our engineering and research teams into clear, engaging content Coming up with creative ideas to increase awareness of Neuphonic and our products Helping organise events, demos, conferences and other marketing activities Supporting campaigns and identifying interesting companies, communities and audiences to reach Writing case studies, blog posts, newsletters and other marketing materials Tracking the performance of campaigns and content and learning what works Keeping our website, social channels and marketing materials up to date Jumping into ad hoc projects and helping wherever needed as the company grows This is a broad role with lots of ownership. Some weeks you might be helping launch a new model, others you might be creating content from a research paper, organising an event or testing a new campaign. jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA
jobs.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. We are seeking an experienced Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA to lead new business acquisition across EMEA. We are investing aggressively to capture the Enterprise opportunity in front of us, and we are moving upmarket fast. We are looking for a builder: someone who will pave the way upmarket and build a real Enterprise sales playbook from the ground up, rather than inherit one. Our segmentation reflects where we are on that journey. Enterprise is currently defined as companies with 400 or more employees, which makes it a broad segment. You will lead a team running a high volume of mid-sized deals at the lower end alongside the larger, complex enterprise deals at the top. Building a single motion that serves both, without compromising either, is one of the central challenges of this role. What you’ll do as a Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA at Vanta: Define and build the Enterprise motion in EMEA: setting a clear multi-year vision aligned to GTM objectives, creating the playbook, processes, and deal strategy behind it, and evolving it as the market shifts Own the EMEA Enterprise number, driving pipeline generation, win rate, average deal size, sales cycle length, and quota attainment Get hands-on in your team's most strategic deals, joining customer conversations, coaching in the moment, and helping close the deals that set the standard for what Enterprise looks like at Vanta Hire, mentor, and develop your Managers and AEs as the team scales, and create clear career paths into Enterprise and leadership roles Deliver an accurate weekly forecast, and build the inspection cadence, deal reviews and pipeline hygiene that make it trustworthy Partner with senior sales leadership, marketing, RevOps, product marketing, partnerships and enablement to align the region around a unified GTM strategy Bring the voice of the EMEA Enterprise buyer back into the business, influencing product priorities, pricing, packaging and regional investment Represent Vanta at industry events and customer meetings across the region How to be successful in this role: Proven, repeated track record as a builder: creating Enterprise playbooks from scratch rather than inheriting them, and taking a company or region upmarket from mid-market roots Experience leading frontline sales leaders at a SaaS company. Consistent record of achieving and exceeding Enterprise new business targets across multiple EMEA markets, with a real understanding of how buying behavior, procurement and security review differ across the region Comfort operating across a broad segment, from a high volume of mid-sized deals through to large, complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals Mastery of a value-based selling methodology such as Command of the Message, and the ability to coach it rather than just quote it Rigorous command of the key metrics of the business: uses data to diagnose issues, prioritize investment and forecast accurately, and builds business cases that influence executive stakeholders Strong executive presence: builds credible relationships with CISOs, CIOs and other senior buyers, and communicates strategy, performance and investment plans to senior leadership with clarity Strong eye for talent, both in hiring and in advancing the careers of Vantans Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to create clarity for a team through periods of rapid growth and change Enthusiasm for cybersecurity and for helping customers build trusted businesses Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. jobs.title: Data Architect
jobs.description: <h2>Opportunity</h2> <p>Brunswick is accelerating its use of AI to strengthen the advice we give clients and how we operate. We are looking for a Data Architect to join our AI Lab and shape the technical and data foundations that enable us to build and scale proprietary AI products securely and effectively.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, influential role spanning architecture and practical delivery. You will take a portfolio-wide view of how data, applications, models, APIs and shared components fit together, creating reusable patterns and capabilities that help engineers move faster while maintaining high standards of security, resilience and maintainability.</p> <p>Working closely with AI Engineers, Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams, you will ensure the Lab has the architecture and underlying platform it needs to innovate at pace while aligning with Brunswick’s wider technology environment.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:</p> <ul> <li>Design and evolve the data and technical architecture underpinning the AI Lab’s portfolio of proprietary products.</li> <li>Define scalable patterns for how applications, data sources, models, APIs and enterprise systems connect and interact.</li> <li>Design approaches to data modelling, access, storage, movement and governance, particularly for sensitive or business-critical information.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to create reusable services, components and data capabilities that accelerate development across multiple products.</li> <li>Establish standards and patterns for data pipelines, APIs, integration, environments, deployment and observability.</li> <li>Work closely with engineers to translate architectural principles into practical solutions, balancing scalability with rapid prototyping and delivery.</li> <li>Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams to ensure solutions meet Brunswick’s security, privacy, governance and architectural standards.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to simplify the data landscape, reduce duplication and improve interoperability across the firm.</li> <li>Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural approaches that could strengthen the Lab’s platform or unlock new capabilities.</li> <li>Help build the scalable data foundations Brunswick needs to develop and deploy AI responsibly, securely and effectively.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <p>You will combine strong data and solution architecture skills with a practical engineering mindset and the ability to operate in a fast-moving product environment. You will be comfortable moving between strategic architecture and detailed technical decisions, making pragmatic trade-offs between long-term scalability and speed of delivery. The successful candidate will bring:</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>6+ years of relevant experience in data architecture, solution architecture, data engineering, software engineering or a related technical role.</li> <li>Strong experience designing scalable data and application architectures, ideally in cloud environments.</li> <li>Experience designing data models, APIs, integrations and data flows across databases, SaaS applications and enterprise systems.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of modern data architecture, including data modelling, ETL/ELT pipelines, storage, access patterns, data warehouses, lakes/lakehouses and governance.</li> <li>Experience with cloud platforms; Microsoft Azure experience is particularly relevant.</li> <li>Good working knowledge of SQL and modern data engineering approaches, including Python.</li> <li>Experience designing reusable tech

jobs.title: Senior Integrated Marketing Manager (Global Campaigns)
jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand. We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets. Here's what your day-to-day might look like: Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution. Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns. Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals. Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics. Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance. What You'll Need to Thrive Essential Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation. Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions. Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority. Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy. Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact. Nice to Have Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments. Background working across international or multi-market structures. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. jobs.description: About Us Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations. We are headquartered in London and our team works across Europe. We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you. The Role We are hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to build the product surfaces that housing providers, contractors, and residents use every day. This is a fully remote position; we currently have remote engineers based in the UK, Germany, Turkey, Poland, Italy, Spain, and Portugal. You will report to a Team Lead, a hands-on engineer who still writes code and has a small number of engineers reporting to them, and work alongside product managers, designers, backend engineers, and data analysts. Our frontend is built on TypeScript, React, React Router, TanStack Query, MaterialUI and BaseUI, against an increasingly service-oriented backend built in Django REST Framework and PostgreSQL. jobs.description: About Sona Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. You'll build a clear picture of the lay of the land, take the route that gets us there fastest and bring in the right people from Product, Commercial, our customers and local specialists when they're needed. Day to day, that means keeping a lot of moving parts pointed in the same direction, with stakeholders across our customers, Product and the wider Sona team, and relationships that are rarely simple. You'll own the relationships with our first Italian customers, and build a network of local labour specialists, consultancy-based, whilst you deliver those first implementations. This role isn't for everyone. If you want a defined process and clear direction on what to do next, you'll find it frustrating. If you love ambiguity and changes of plan, take ownership of every implementation and make the next one better than the last, you'll shape how Sona implements in Italy from the start. Responsibilities Work out how Sona implements in Italy, and capture what you learn so each implementation starts from a better place than the last. Build a network of local labour specialists in Italy, consultancy-based, whilst delivering implementations. Bring in the right people at the right moment, and make calls without waiting to be told what to do. Manage risks, dependencies and scope, and communicate changes clearly to everyone affected. Keep finding better ways to implement, and put them into practice on the next project. Requirements You're a native Italian speaker with fluent English. jobs.title: CDI - Senior Platform Engineer - Paris
jobs.description: <p><strong>Mission</strong></p> <p>Des groupes de premier plan font tourner leur IA sur ce que vous construisez. Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vos utilisateurs sont d’autres équipes d’ingénierie et si la robustesse d’un système sous charge vous intéresse.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. jobs.title: CDI - Senior AI Strategist - Paris
jobs.description: <p><strong>Prenez en main un stream de transformation IA, au contact direct des clients, de la vision aux résultats mesurables.</strong></p> <p>L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction.<br>Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes.&nbsp;</p> <p>Et tout commence par vous.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Mission</strong></p> <p>En tant que <strong>Senior AI Strategist</strong>, vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients : vous cadrez, analysez, prototypez et recommandez, vous coachez les consultants juniors, et vous voyez vos recommandations prendre vie avec nos équipes Engineering.</p> <p>Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier.</p> <p>Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous cadrez les processus cibles et la roadmap de votre stream, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour.</p> <p><br><strong>Activités &amp; Responsabilités</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA</strong></li> </ul> <p>Vous contribuez à cadrer la vision IA et à la roadmap du stream, qualifiez et priorisez les cas d’usage, et arbitrez entre solutions IA et non-IA. Vous investiguez les processus métier, identifiez les irritants et les causes racines, et proposez des pistes de refonte priorisées, en pensant d’abord lean et en n’utilisant l’IA que là où elle apporte de la valeur. Vous contribuez également à la conception du modèle opératoire cible et à ses conditions de succès.</p> <ul> <li><strong> Analyses, business cases &amp; prototypage</strong></li> </ul> <p>Vous concevez et pilotez les travaux d’analyse du stream afin de sécuriser des décisions fondées sur les données et sur les faits : vous collectez et validez les données, revoyez les analyses des consultants juniors, construisez des business cases de bout en bout et formulez des recommandations. Vous prototypez des cas d’usage avec des outils agentiques pour illustrer la valeur par la démo et aider les clients à se projeter dans la solution finale.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Delivery, livrables &amp; collaboration</strong></li> </ul> <p>Vous pilotez au quotidien la livraison d’un stream ou d’une mission cadrée : vous construisez le rétro-planning, identifiez les risques et blocages, proposez des solutions et donnez de la visibilité au N+1 et aux équipes du client. Vous produisez des sections de livrables de niveau C-suite, rédigez les storylines du stream, participez aux synthèses exécutives sur votre périmètre et construisez un narratif qui appuie la recommandation et emporte l’adhésion. Vous coordonnez votre stream avec les équipes Engineering pour la faisabilité technique et avec les équipes AI Adoption pour ancrer l’adoption sur le terrain.</p> <ul> <li><strong> Relation client &amp; développement commercial</strong></li> </ul

jobs.description: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun   a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain . Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur ! Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux. Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure. 🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe. 🎯  Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous Le Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF) est une Unité Mixte de Recherche du CNRS (UMR 5307). Situé à l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne et porté par deux tutelles (Mines Saint-Étienne et CNRS), le laboratoire regroupe tout le potentiel de recherche de Mines Saint-Étienne dans les domaines des matériaux, de la mécanique et des procédés. Le centre SMS - Sciences des Matériaux et des Structures - est l’un des cinq centres d’enseignement et de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne. Au sein du LGF, il développe des recherches en science des matériaux, mécanique et procédés avancés de fabrication, pour le transport et la production d'énergie, avec un objectif d’accroître la durabilité des matériaux. Ce post-doc s'inscrit dans le cadre de la chaire « SIRA », un partenariat de quatre ans entre Mines Saint-Etienne et les sociétés Framatome et EDF, co-financé par l'Agence Nationale de la Recherche, portant sur le vieillissement des aciers faiblement alliés (16MND5) utilisés dans les composants du circuit primaire des réacteurs nucléaires à eau pressurisée. Ce post-doc est organisé selon quatre axes de travail. Le premier axe de travail concernera l’utilisation de l’hydrogène pour favoriser la rupture intergranulaire, préalable indispensable à la spectrométrie Auger sur fracture. Ceci permettra d’accéder à des niveaux de ségrégation faibles, insuffisants pour provoquer une fragilité intergranulaire « intrinsèque ». L’hydrogène est connu pour exacerber, dans certains cas, la fragilité intergranulaire. Il s’agira ici d’explorer les conditions dans lesquelles on peut obtenir pour l’acier de cuve des ruptures intergranulaires assistées par l’hydrogène. On pourra notamment étudier l’effet de la concentration d’hydrogène (introduit par chargement cathodique par exemple) et de la vitesse de sollicitation mécanique. La chaire pourra bénéficier ici des compétences du laboratoire sur la fragilisation par l'hydrogène. jobs.description: Unité : CERI Energie Environnement - DEMO MERA/LCSQA Responsables : Emmanuel TISON, Anthony LAGACHE Catégorie : Stagiaire de Master 2 ou de fin d’études ingénieur (6 mois) Lieu de travail : Douai – Bourseul, Bâtiment Curie   Contexte : École sous tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle, énergétique et numérique, et école de l’Institut Mines Télécom, IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.   Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20000m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les domaines suivants : Systèmes Numériques Energie Environnement Matériaux et Procédés   Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr .   Le stage est à pourvoir au sein du Centre d’Enseignement, de Recherche et d’Innovation Energie Environnement (CERI EE) de l’IMT Nord Europe. Une partie des missions du CERI EE (https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri/) est de réaliser des travaux techniques et scientifiques pour le Ministère chargé de l’Environnement dans le cadre du Laboratoire Central de Surveillance de la Qualité de l’Air (LCSQA, https://www.lcsqa.org/fr) et de l’observatoire de Mesure et Évaluation en zone Rurale de la pollution Atmosphérique à longue distance (MERA, https://www.lcsqa.org/fr/le-dispositif-mera). En concertation avec les Associations Agréées de Surveillance de la Qualité de l'Air (AASQA), le CERI EE est chargé de proposer et qualifier les méthodes de mesure à déployer, de définir les protocoles, d’évaluer la qualité des données et de piloter l’observatoire MERA intégré au dispositif français de surveillance réglementaire de la qualité de l’air.   Contexte : L'ammoniac (NH3) est un polluant atmosphérique nocif pour la santé humaine, les écosystèmes et l'environnement, mais aussi un précurseur de particules fines inorganiques notamment responsables de forts épisodes de pollution printaniers en Europe. En France, la source dominante d'ammoniac (environ 95%) est attribuée aux activités agricoles (épandage de fumier, utilisation d'engrais azotés, élevage). À partir de 2027, la directive européenne 2024/2881 exige que le NH3 soit mesuré spécifiquement sur les supersites implantés dans des lieux caractéristiques de la pollution de fond rurale. La France répond à cette obligation en déployant 6 supersites de surveillance de typologie fond rural, répartis dans des zones représentatives de la pollution longue-distance, et sélectionnés au sein des stations de l’observatoire MERA. Ces supersites sont équipés d’analyseurs automatiques en continu pour mesurer le NH3 à une très haute résolution temporelle. Ces méthodes permettent une mesure en temps réel, pour capturer la variabilité temporelle du NH3. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry. Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage. Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied. At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it. Building and maintaining these indices within tight time and resource constraints requires highly performant, scalable software. To achieve this, we rely on modern technologies in distributed and parallel computing, database systems, and cloud platforms. You’ll leverage the strengths of these technologies to meet demanding throughput and latency requirements. jobs.description: Arbeitsbeginn Anfang März 2027 · 80–100 % Pensum · St. Gallen Bei alunir glauben wir an die kleinen magischen Momente im Alltag. Mit unseren bedeutungsvollen Schmuckstücken möchten wir nicht nur Freude schenken, sondern auch etwas Gutes bewirken. Für unseren bestehenden alunir Store in St. Gallen suchen wir eine herzliche, engagierte und verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit, die unser Team bereichert und gemeinsam mit uns besondere Einkaufserlebnisse schafft. Als Verkaufsberater:in mit Stv. Funktion unterstützt du die Store Managerin bei der Führung und Organisation unseres neuen Standorts, übernimmst Verantwortung im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst gemeinsam mit deinem Team für ein besonderes Einkaufserlebnis. Deine Mission ✨ Du unterstützt die Store Managerin bei der operativen und organisatorischen Führung des Stores. Bei ihrer Abwesenheit übernimmst du die Verantwortung für das Tagesgeschäft und bist die erste Ansprechperson für dein Team. Du bist aktiv im Verkauf tätig und begeisterst unsere Kundinnen und Kunden mit persönlicher Beratung und echter Gastfreundschaft. Du unterstützt bei der Führung, Motivation und Einarbeitung der Mitarbeitenden und lebst unsere Werte und Qualitätsstandards vor. Du erkennst Handlungsbedarf, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst für reibungslose Abläufe im Store. Du kümmerst dich um das Waren- und Lagermanagement sowie eine ansprechende Warenpräsentation. Du unterstützt bei organisatorischen Aufgaben wie der Personaleinsatzplanung und bringst eigene Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung des Stores ein. Was du mitbringst 💫 Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Detailhandel, idealerweise in der Schmuck-, Mode- oder Lifestylebranche. Erste Führungserfahrung oder die Motivation, den nächsten Schritt in eine Führungsposition zu machen. Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Menschen zu motivieren und im Team zusammenzuarbeiten. Eine herzliche, offene Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Kundenorientierung. Selbstständigkeit, Organisationstalent und ein hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein. Ein gutes Gespür für Ästhetik und Warenpräsentation. Fliessende (Schweizer-)Deutschkenntnisse und gute bis sehr gute Englischkenntnisse. Flexibilität und Bereitschaft für regelmässige Samstagseinsätze. Und natürlich eine grosse Portion alunir Magie. ✨ Deine ersten Monate 🌙 Dein Abenteuer bei alunir beginnt Anfang März 2027 in unserem Store in St. Gallen. Während deiner sorgfältigen Einarbeitung lernst du unsere Schmuckstücke, Abläufe, Werte und die alunir Philosophie kennen. Du wirst Schritt für Schritt in deine Aufgaben eingeführt und erhältst die Möglichkeit, unser eingespieltes Team und den Storealltag kennenzulernen. Gemeinsam mit der Store Managerin wächst du in deine Stellvertretungsfunktion hinein, übernimmst zunehmend Verantwortung und bringst deine eigenen Stärken und Ideen in den Storealltag ein. Was wir dir bieten 💛 Eine unbefristete Anstellung mit fünf Wochen Ferien und attraktiven Mitarbeitendenrabatten. Eine abwechslungsreiche Position mit Verantwortung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Die Möglichkeit, in einem bestehenden Store Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dessen Weiterentwicklung aktiv mitzugestalten. Ein herzliches, familiäres Team mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Eine sorgfältige Einarbeitung und persönliche Begleitung. Raum für eigene Ideen und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld in einem Schweizer Schmucklabel, das mit jedem verkauften Schmuckstück auch etwas Gutes bewirkt. Ability to take ownership of an open-ended technical problem and carry it through implementation, testing, and field validation. MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated engineering experience. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Planning & Navigation)
jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases. You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation. What You'll Work On Navigation and path-planning design: how robots represent traversable space, select routes, avoid obstacles, and reach goals across complex sites. Sensor integration driven by navigation requirements, including what ground segmentation and traversability estimation need in day, night, and challenging weather. Environment understanding: how the robot distinguishes ground from obstacles and estimates which terrain is safe and practical to traverse. Behavior prediction: anticipate how people, vehicles, and other dynamic obstacles will move, and plan routes that stay safe and efficient around them. Field reliability: reproduce failures from deployments, find the root cause, and fix it at the right layer, from sensor data and maps to costmaps, planners, and recovery behaviors. Planning under imperfect localization: plans that stay useful when the state estimate drifts and the robot must execute routes in tight or dynamic environments, working with the rest of Robot Autonomy on localization and control. Validation on real robots: logs, simulation, and repeatable field tests to verify that design choices and changes hold across routes, lighting, weather, and site layouts. New autonomy capabilities: work with the engineers building the operator application and backend so operator requests and new robot capabilities rest on a sound navigation design. The field feedback loop: work closely with forward-deployed engineers to turn site issues into bugs, design changes, and improvements to the navigation stack. Regular site visits to build a practical understanding of how robots and sensors behave in real operating conditions. Who We're Looking For We're looking for an engineer who has taken a robotics system from unreliable to dependable and takes ownership beyond individual tickets. You can explain why you made a navigation design choice and what it costs. When a robot takes a bad route, you can tell whether the planner, the map, the state estimate, or the robot's behavior is at fault, and you fix the right one. You are comfortable in the field and want to understand how robots behave in real customer environments. The Role As a Software Engineer intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll train locomotion and low-level control policies for our legged security robots and help take them from simulation to real hardware. You'll work close to the actuators, from joint-level behavior through coordinated locomotion, on robots that patrol outdoor sites across varied terrain and challenging weather. This role is highly practical: you'll design training setups, run experiments in simulation, transfer policies to physical robots, and measure how they hold up. You'll get hands-on experience with the gap between a policy that works in simulation and one that keeps a robot on its feet on wet ground at night. What You'll Work On Train and evaluate reinforcement learning policies for locomotion and low-level control in simulation. Apply sim-to-real techniques such as domain randomization, reward design, and policy robustness methods, and test the results on physical robots. Make policies robust to varied terrain, challenging weather, and noisy, delayed, or missing sensor data. Explore control approaches that transfer across robot embodiments with different actuators and dynamics. Build evaluation workflows with clear metrics and repeatable experiments, in simulation and on hardware. Je bent minimaal drie maanden fulltime beschikbaar. Een vierdaagse werkweek is bespreekbaar. We hebben een voorkeur voor studenten van een hbo-opleiding of een master journalistiek, maar ook anderen zijn van harte welkom om te solliciteren. De Volkskrant streeft een diverse redactie na: we nodigen stagiairs met een biculturele achtergrond nadrukkelijk uit werkervaring bij ons op te doen. Wat bieden wij? Een leuke en leerzame periode bij de grootste kwaliteitskrant van Nederland. Intensieve begeleiding door je chef en ervaren redacteuren.  De stage duurt in principe drie maanden. jobs.description: Middelburg- Zet jij de Zeeuwse sport elke dag op de kaart? Als Coördinator Regiosport bij de PZC geef je richting aan onze sportjournalistiek in Zeeland. Facility Management, Hotel Management, Hospitality Management. Je hebt een passie voor gastvrijheid en eventorganisatie, met specifieke interesse in het neerzetten van vlekkeloze bijeenkomsten en unieke belevenissen voor onze collega's en bezoekers. jobs.title: Product Owner

Je vertaalt inzichten uit klantgesprekken, data en gebruikersonderzoek naar concrete en uitvoerbare features. Daarmee lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de doorontwikkeling van een platform dat 872000 unieke bezoekers per maand ontvangt. Zonder jouw regie ontstaat onduidelijkheid over prioriteiten, scope en requirements, waardoor de ontwikkeling van het platform vertraagt. Het eerste aanspreekpunt te zijn voor developers, UX en de Tech Lead bij functionele vragen en binnen de gestelde kaders zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen over scope en uitwerking. De scope tijdens development te bewaken, functionele validaties voor te bereiden met testscenario's en acceptatiechecks en opgeleverde features te controleren op iOS, Android en web. Wie zijn wij? Wij zijn Reclamefolder.nl. Wij geloven dat het mogelijk is om mensen te helpen besparen op hun dagelijkse uitgaven. Onze website en apps ontvangen wij maandelijks 875000 unieke gebruikers en onze ambitie reikt verder.
