In deze rol geef je de Product Manager ruimte om zich te richten op discovery, strategie en klantcontact, terwijl jij zorgt voor een backlog met features die klaar zijn om ontwikkeld te worden. Ervaring met het schrijven van duidelijke user stories en acceptatiecriteria die zonder aanvullende toelichting door ontwikkelaars kunnen worden opgepakt. Het vermogen om stakeholderverzoeken te vertalen naar een helder probleem met een duidelijke scope en prioriteit, waarbij je waar nodig duidelijke keuzes maakt. Pré Ervaring met digitale producten die beschikbaar zijn op iOS, Android en web. Ervaring binnen retail media, advertising, e-commerce of marketplaces. jobs.description: Amsterdam or Antwerp – As a Backend Engineer within the GenAI Platform team, you help build the foundation that enables AI products across DPG Media. Ready to make an impact on the future of AI at DPG Media? Read on! What will you do? As a Backend Engineer, you take ownership of the platform capabilities that enable teams across DPG Media to securely use and manage AI products. You build backend services that unify user, access, usage and cost data while making architectural decisions that support the platform's continued growth. Your work ensures that new products and teams can be onboarded efficiently and consistently. Designing scalable platform architecture that continues to perform as the number of products grows. Defining how platform resources are described so new products and teams can be added through configuration instead of custom development. Who are we? We are a small team that builds and operates the GenAI Platform used across DPG Media. The platform runs on Kubernetes and provides teams throughout the organisation with access to AI products, ranging from workflow automation to model hosting. What makes you the ideal candidate? Experience integrating third-party APIs and combining data from multiple sources into one consistent view. Hands-on experience with OAuth2/OIDC, role-based access models and running services on Kubernetes. Experience adding metrics and alerts to the services you build. Additional experience with Go, Kubernetes controllers or operators, declarative reconcile-based systems, usage metering, FinOps data, Terraform or GenAI systems is considered an advantage. How do you work? You take ownership of your work from design through delivery and beyond. You focus on delivering practical solutions first and continuously improve them. You proactively identify opportunities for improvement, clearly explain your reasoning and remain open to alternative perspectives. Als Senior Product Owner weet je dat. Je hebt de complexe omgevingen gezien, de politieke stakeholders, de systemen met twintig jaar technische schuld. Je bent niet op zoek naar een functie waarbij je uren vult. Je zoekt een omgeving die jou scherp houdt. De uitdaging Bij LINKIT werk je als Senior Product Owner op opdracht bij organisaties waar de complexiteit hoog is: ministeries, grote corporates, data-intensieve omgevingen waar één verkeerde prioritering maanden vertraging oplevert. Jij bent de schakel tussen strategie en levering, tussen de directie die richting wil en het team dat die richting uitvoerbaar moet maken. Dat betekent in de praktijk dat je eindverantwoordelijk bent voor backlog, prioritering en roadmap, en dat je die verantwoordelijkheid neemt ook als stakeholders tegengestelde belangen hebben. Je vertaalt abstracte organisatiedoelen naar concrete productkeuzes. Je stuurt op waarde én op compliance, op snelheid én op continuïteit. En je laat teams en producten structureel beter achter dan je ze aantrof. Je gaat in dienst bij LINKIT en gaat op opdracht bij klanten in sectoren als overheid, finance en logistiek. De techniek, omgeving en prioriteiten van de omgevingen wisselen; de verwachting dat jij eigenaarschap pakt, niet. Jouw plek Bij LINKIT werken we in squads, dit zijn onze expertise teams. Elke twee weken is er de clubdag: alle Explorers komen op vrijdag terug naar het hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor kennissessies, verdieping en verbinding. Tot 10% van je werktijd gaat naar leren en groeien, niet als bijzaak maar als onderdeel van hoe LINKIT werkt. Wat we vragen Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Product Owner in complexe IT-omgevingen. Aantoonbare Agile/Scrum ervaring; SAFe is een sterke pré. PSPO I en PSPO II certificering (aanvullende certificeringen zijn een pré). Ervaring binnen enterprise-organisaties, overheid of infra-omgevingen. Affiniteit met data-intensieve omgevingen en begrip van architectuur, integraties, migraties, security en compliance op hoofdlijnen. Afgeronde hbo-opleiding. Professionele beheersing van Nederlands en Engels. Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact. Wat je krijgt Salaris tussen €6.000-€7.000 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld. Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling. Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis. 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken. Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding. Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken. Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega's terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag). Extra's zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, , zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga. Sollicitatieprocedure We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet. Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is. Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod. Vragen vooraf? Neem contact op met Siënna via Over LINKIT LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. Verkennen van nieuwe technologieën, producten en partners om versnelling continu mogelijk te maken. jobs.title: AI Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Hoe lang duurt dit ziekteverzuim? Hoeveel stroom levert het windpark morgen? Welke klant staat open voor een volgend product? Organisaties willen het antwoord weten voordat het zover is. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer zorg jij dat die voorspelling er komt: betrouwbaar, herhaalbaar en verankerd in het werk van echte gebruikers. De uitdaging Generatieve AI trekt de aandacht, maar predictive AI levert vaak de harde waarde. De twee lossen verschillende problemen op en versterken elkaar. Jij weet welke aanpak bij welk vraagstuk past, en waar de grenzen liggen.  Als AI Machine Learning Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers ,    zoals overheden, ASML, InsingerGilissen en KLM. Daar tref je vaak data waar nog veel meer uit te halen valt. Jij maakt er producten op basis van AI van die werken. Je werk bestaat onder meer uit: Statistische analyses en dataverkenning om haalbaarheid en aanpak snel helder te krijgen. Data pipelines bouwen en de juiste featureset samenstellen voor modeltraining. Modellen ontwikkelen, van gradient boosting tot deep learning. Modelregistratie, experiment tracking en modelvisualisaties op orde houden. Modellen ontsluiten via FastAPI, zodat ze aanroepbaar zijn binnen het bestaande applicatielandschap. Met coding agents vind je sneller de juiste libraries en creeër je inzicht zodat de haalbaarheid en juiste aanpak snel boven water komen. Je adviseert gebruikers en stakeholders over wat AI wel en niet kan. Je werkt pragmatisch en zet door tot de mensen voor wie je modellen bedoeld zijn ze dagelijks gebruiken. Je plek Je sluit aan bij de AI& Data Squad: Explorers die al jaren AI toepassen en elkaar scherp houden. AI is voor LINKIT een strategisch speerpunt waar we de komende jaren flink in investeren. Onze ambitie is dé partij voor integere AI-oplossingen in Nederland te worden. Daarvoor bouwen we aan nieuwe proposities, van verantwoorde AI op Europese infrastructuur tot voorspelmodellen op Databricks. Jij denkt daar actief over mee. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag met alle Explorers samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag: een dag voor kennisdelen, leren en verbinden.  Lees  hier  meer over de AI squad. Wat we vragen Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring als ontwikkelaar, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar met AI en machine learning. Een stevige basis in data science of software engineering. Ervaring met modellen en frameworks zoals LightGBM, XGBoost en Keras. Ervaring met platformen als Azure ML, Databricks, AWS SageMaker of GCP Vertex AI. Ervaring met pandas, polars of Spark, en met exploratie in Jupyter en Seaborn. Ervaring met tracking en orkestratie via MLflow, Prefect of Airflow. Je kunt onderbouwen welk model of welke tool in welke situatie het beste werkt, en je maakt je nieuwe tools snel eigen. Je volgt generatieve AI op de voet, van prompt via context naar harness engineering, en weet hoe je oplossingen met LLM’s evalueert, monitort en verbetert. You will own measurement and analysis for a product area, turn ambiguous questions into testable hypotheses, and use evidence to guide product decisions. Our teams operate through clear success metrics, rapid learning, and controlled experiments. For new categories and ordering formats, define the measures that show whether customers find value and whether the model can scale. Build a trusted measurement foundation: Define and document product metrics, cohorts, event tracking, and dashboards. Work with Engineering and Data partners to validate instrumentation and maintain reliable behavioral data. Create compelling dashboards that let product teams explore results, spot meaningful patterns, and monitor outcomes after launch. jobs.title: Director, Digital Analytics & Experimentation
jobs.description: iFIT ’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey. We're hiring a Director, Digital Analytics & Experimentation to own the numbers behind our direct-to-consumer business on nordictrack.com. This is an AI-first, global role spanning analytics, reporting, forecasting and experimentation, with subscription growth and the customer journey at the center. Leaders across the company make spending, pricing and merchandising decisions on your numbers. Why join iFIT and NordicTrack Connected fitness is a growing category at the center of health and wellness, and iFIT and NordicTrack are right in it. We sell more than equipment: the iFIT membership keeps customers training, so every conversion, test and forecast is a lifetime-value decision, not a one-time sale. As our Director, you'll be the person leadership turns to for what's working, what's next and what it's worth, with a direct line to the executives making the calls. You'll shape the nordictrack.com experience, grow customer lifetime value, and help us move to a new AI-driven personalization platform. We expect AI in every part of the job, to move faster and surface opportunities manual analysis would miss. What you'll do The role splits roughly evenly across three areas, and you own the integrity of all three. Analytics and data Pull and validate data from web analytics, order, media and finance sources, and keep documented KPI definitions as one source of truth. Diagnose performance changes by traffic source, product and funnel step, and make recommendations supported by quantified evidence. Track, analyze and report on our subscription economics, including customer lifetime value (LTV) and the annual iFIT subscription attach rate, and show what moves them. Map the customer journey from first visit through purchase and subscription, find what drives conversion and what blocks it, and tell us where to optimize first. Reporting and forecasting Own the daily, weekly and monthly performance reporting and the dashboards behind it, including LTV and subscription attach. Prepare executive-ready summaries of results versus plan and prior year, with the drivers behind each variance. Build and maintain the full P&L forecast for the DTC business, from traffic, conversion and subscription attach through revenue, margin and marketing spend, including media mix. Reconcile forecasts to actuals and finance, explain every variance, refresh the outlook regularly, and model scenarios (promotions, media shifts, pricing) with the assumptions written down. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. We do this by being objective, trusted partners to the Sales Leadership team. jobs.title: Chemical Data Scientist
jobs.description: About Valdera : At Valdera, we empower innovators to turn ideas into reality by transforming how manufacturers source materials. We make it effortless for companies to find the best materials and suppliers for their needs, enabling them to build high-quality products at scale and deliver them to millions of consumers worldwide. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with a proven track record of working with Fortune 500 industrial manufacturers, beauty brands, and chemical companies. We are a fast-growing company that hires talented, hardworking people who excel in high-performance environments and want to grow their careers quickly. Our culture is built for exceptional individuals to take on meaningful challenges, collaborate with the top minds in our industry, and see the direct impact of their work. If you’re looking for a fast-paced environment where your ideas will drive real change, Valdera is the place for you. Join us, and let’s shape the future of manufacturing together. Role Description: We are hiring a C hemical Data Scientist to build and maintain the pipelines that keep Valdera's supplier and chemical product data accurate, current, and structured — the foundation every buyer and supplier relies on across Valdera's procurement platform. Data quality plays a critical role at Valdera. When a buyer launches a request, they expect to be matched with the right suppliers and accurate specs on the first try. Delivering that depends on clean, current data — CAS numbers, specifications, certifications, and regulatory documents pulled from thousands of inconsistent, often messy sources. This requires strong data engineering fundamentals and a working knowledge of chemical industry data. For example, you might take dozens of differently structured chemical supplier catalogs and turn them into one clean, standardized product database. You will take ownership of the full data pipeline — from scrapers and ETL workflows to data cleaning, matching, and classification models that connect suppliers to buyer requirements. You're energized by messy, real-world data and confident partnering with Supplier Management and Engineering to close coverage gaps. As a data-obsessed professional, you're dedicated to the accuracy our buyers and suppliers depend on. Role Responsibilities: Design and build pipelines to collect supplier data and chemical product information (specifications, CAS numbers, certifications, SDS/regulatory documents, NAICS classification of manufacturing plants) from supplier sites, distributor catalogs, trade databases, and other public and semi-structured sources Develop and maintain web scrapers and automated ETL workflows to keep supplier and product data current at scale Clean, normalize, and reconcile inconsistent supplier data into structured, standardized formats suitable for internal tools and analytics Apply chemical domain knowledge to validate and enrich data — resolving product names, CAS numbers, synonyms, and specifications across suppliers Evaluate and improve matching and classification models to map suppliers and products to buyer requirements, and to identify overlapping or equivalent chemical offerings Partner with Supplier Management and Engineering to define data quality standards, identify gaps in supplier coverage, and prioritize new data sources. Own pipeline health and data quality, and drive the KPIs that measure overall data coverage Experience & Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in a data science, data engineering, or applied data role, ideally with exposure to messy, real-world or industrial datasets. Working knowledge of chemistry or chemical industry data — comfort with CAS numbers, chemical properties, SDS documents, NAICS classification, and supplier certifications Strong Python skills, with experience building web scrapers and data pipelines Experience with data cleaning and normalization at scale, and a good eye for spotting inconsistencies in unstructured data

jobs.title: GTA VI Researcher
jobs.description: What is Kalshi ? Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets. Role Roadmap This is a real job. We’re looking for someone whose parents said video games would never pay the bills. They were wrong, and you can tell them we said so. As Kalshi’s GTA VI Researcher, you’ll begin at midnight on November 19 and play until you beat the story. You’ll stream the entire journey, investigate Leonida’s economy, and study what happens to the real economy when everyone suddenly has a “family emergency” on launch day. We want the person who finds the optimal money-making strategy, builds a spreadsheet to prove it, and gets accused of ruining the game for everyone else. What You’ll Do Lock in for live launch. Launch-night stream starts at midnight, then play through the story at your own pace. Sleep and touching grass are both allowed (your schedule, your call). Streams on Twitch or YouTube, cam on (thatʼs the deliverable format). How you run your stream is up to you. An official State of the Leonida Economy address, based on your study of the Leonida economy. Real-world fallout analysis: who called in “sick,” how DoorDash carried the entire nation through launch week, and how much productivity America lost. Min-max everything. Find whatʼs broken, whatʼs mid, and whatʼs actually goated, and bring receipts. Drop a weekly research report on the Leonida economy. What You Bring An established gamer and streamer with your own channel: 18+ years of life IRL, 10+ years of sweaty gaming, 3+ years of streaming experience. Your own setup (equipment, internet, and software). You need to know how a system works, how to optimize it, and whether the guide everyone is following is actually wrong. Fees $100,000-120,000 fixed project fee. $15,000 project completion fee. Our Culture Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets. Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1. Commitment to Equal Opportunity Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.description: Who We Are Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too. We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more. Our team is small relative to our impact, and we believe our user success is our success (not the inverse). A team member summarized: “Roboflow is a company full of giant brains and tiny egos.” We find software has a multiplier effect on all roles (not only product and engineering), so Roboflow employs developers across the company in design, sales, customer support, marketing, and beyond. We’re supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Google Ventures, Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors. What You'll Do As a Research Scientist, you will originate and drive the novel machine learning research directions that shape Roboflow's research agenda. Because of Roboflow’s huge userbase, we have a unique visibility into how people are using computer vision in the real world, including in what circumstances existing methods are unable to solve user problems. Our Research Team’s mission is to introduce novel methods that generalize as well as possible across our userbase. This includes methods that learn well on diverse data, run efficiently on different hardware targets, and solve unique categories of problems. You will identify the most promising open problems in computer vision, develop original theoretical approaches and algorithms to address them, and publish your work at top conferences. You'll partner closely with our engineering team, who will take your research and translate it into production systems running at scale. Who You Are You are a pragmatic, experienced machine learning researcher who wants to be an important part of an exceptional team that focuses on using Roboflow's computer vision tools to impact and improve every industry. You have high agency and a bias toward action. Masters / PhD in AI, machine learning, computer vision, robotics, or similar technical field of study, or equivalent industry experience History of publication at conferences / journals (CVPR, NeurIPS, ICLR, etc.) Deep understanding of ML theory and a track record of turning open problems into novel, well-formed research directions Values scientific rigour and reproducibility Passionate about computer vision and solving problems users value Pragmatic approach to utility in practice (not just in theory) Cares about open source and the broader research/developer ecosystem Writes and communicates clearly — able to explain your work to the scientific community, the developer community, and non-research stakeholders inside Roboflow Preferred but not required: Familiarity with the practical constraints of optimizing models for edge hardware and training models on distributed infrastructure Experience collaborating with engineering teams to move research from prototype to production Where You'll Work Roboflow’s team is distributed across the world. We currently have Hubs in New York City, San Francisco, and Brazil (and plan to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. jobs.title: Director of AI/ML
jobs.description: Director of AI/ML In Brief We're an early-stage startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. Lead Bayesian Health's AI/ML organization with a hands-on, scrappy approach: setting technical vision, rolling up your sleeves on critical modeling work, and building a world-class team that ships breakthrough ML products saving lives in hospitals nationwide. Who We Are Bayesian Health's mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We're a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. We're funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association's venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved. What you'll do As Director of AI/ML, you'll set the technical vision and strategy for Bayesian Health's machine learning organization while building and leading a high-performing team of data scientists and ML engineers. You'll partner deeply with Engineering to architect scalable data warehousing and ML infrastructure that enables rapid model development and reliable production deployment. At our stage, you'll also roll up your sleeves on critical IC work: prototyping models, evaluating system performance, and debugging production issues. This role requires thriving in scrappy, early-stage environments where you're building the plane while flying it, translating clinical needs into technical roadmaps, and getting your hands dirty to ship breakthrough healthcare products. Responsibilities Team Leadership : Build, mentor, and scale a world-class AI/ML team, establishing technical standards, career development frameworks, and a culture of excellence and ownership. Technical Vision & Infrastructure : Define and execute the ML roadmap while partnering closely with Engineering to architect data warehousing solutions, ML infrastructure, and data pipelines that enable the team to rapidly prototype and deploy models at scale. Hands-On Modeling & Evaluation: Contribute directly to critical modeling, evaluation, and analysis work, from studies to model performance experiments, ensuring the team ships high-quality ML systems that deliver measurable clinical impact. Cross-Functional Partnership : Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Clinical to translate complex clinical workflows into ML opportunities, and communicate model performance and impact to technical and non-technical stakeholders including customers and investors. Minimum qualifications Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, or related field with 8+ years shipping ML products, and 3+ years leading ML teams at early stage startups Proven track record building and scaling high-performing data science and ML engineering teams in resource-constrained, scrappy environments. Deep technical expertise in production ML systems and data infrastructure, including hands-on experience with data warehousing, real-time prediction, model monitoring, and performance evaluation. Experience working with healthcare or similarly regulated industries where model decisions have high-stakes real-world consequences. Preferred qualifications Experience leading ML organizations through 0-1 product development in healthcare or clinical settings, thriving in environments with limited tooling and infrastructure. Hands-on experience with clinical data standards (HL7, FHIR, EHR) and healthcare ML

jobs.title: Field Intelligence Analyst (Remote, US)
jobs.description: About Sayari : Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv. About the Role Sayari’s customers buy answers to hard problems: who really owns a supplier, where a sanctioned network is moving goods, which alerts deserve an analyst’s time. Sayari’s AI platform Superconductor delivers those answers at machine scale. It is built in the field, with analysts and engineers working alongside customers to define what it needs to do. The Field Intelligence Analyst brings Sayari’s tradecraft to that work. You scope the problem, design the solution, prove its value, and deliver mission impact. You own the analytical relationship for a portfolio of accounts, from first conversation through sustained delivery. What you learn on live engagements flows back into Superconductor and into Sayari’s tradecraft standard. You work in our Field Intelligence Department, a global team of analysts deployed to support government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. You sit in the same org as Forward Deployed Engineers and the Product team. The field shapes the roadmap, and Product sets it. Why This Role Exists Customers buy answers. Superconductor reasons like an expert analyst at machine scale. The analyst’s job shifts from producing every answer by hand to directing, validating, and extending what Superconductor produces, and teaching customer analysts to do the same. Context should survive the contract. The analyst who designed the proof-of-value knows why the success criteria are what they are. Keeping that analyst on the account protects delivery quality and surfaces the next problem before the customer names it. Tradecraft is built in the field. Field Intelligence Analysts see what was promised, what was delivered, and what the customer did with it. That full view produces better methodology, better evals, and a better Superconductor than any single-phase role can. What You Will Do Own the analytical relationship, end to end Run discovery and proof-of-value engagements anchored on work the customer already pays people to do, such as alert adjudication, due diligence, investigations, and case prioritization. Define success criteria you will personally be accountable for delivering. Stay on the account after close and deliver the work you scoped. This includes multi-hop investigations across ownership, trade, and corporate records, plus analytical briefings and training. Serve as the customer’s single analytical point of contact from first conversation through renewal. Build with Field Engineering and Product Pair with FDEs on discovery and delivery. You define the analytical requirement, they build it, and you validate it against the mission. jobs.description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The role: We are looking for a Head of Data Science to build Paddle's data science capability from the ground up. Our Merchant of Record model gives us a data position no PSP or billing provider has: subscription and pricing context alongside granular payment-outcome data, across thousands of software businesses. This role exists to turn that into economic value by putting machine learning and agentic systems into production. The mandate is deliberately narrow and deliberately ambitious: data science at Paddle owns automated decisioning inside the product — traditional machine learning and agentic systems alike — not decision-support analytics. We have a long list of candidate opportunities than we can fund, spanning payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance. We have a working hypothesis about which of these pays back first, and we'll share it — but part of the job in your first quarter is to pressure-test it, size the alternatives yourself, and tell us where to start. This is a founding role, and for the first few quarters it is a building role more than a managing one. You'll be the only person in the function: doing the analysis, engineering the features, training and evaluating the models or agents, taking the first system live with our engineering teams — and then operating it, answerable for its uptime, its drift and its numbers. Once the first use cases are proving out, you'll hire and lead a hub-and-spoke team of data scientists and machine learning engineers embedded across our highest-value business areas. You'll report into the VP of Data and work in close partnership with Product, Payments, Engineering, Risk and Finance. What you'll do: Prioritise which opportunities have the biggest impact.. Build a value-based use-case backlog across payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance; size the leading candidates properly; and make the call on sequencing with the relevant Product, Risk, RevOps and Finance stakeholders. This gets refreshed quarterly. Personally deliver the first system end to end: the analysis and back-test, the features, the model, policy or agent, the deployment, and the shadow and A/B tests that prove it works. Not a spec handed to someone else to build. Operate what you deploy. Own monitoring, retraining, drift response, incident handling and rollback for live decisioning, alongside the engineering teams whose services call it — and set the expectation that the function runs its systems rather than shipping them. Fournir un soutien-conseil technique aux souscripteurs et recommander des mesures visant à réduire l’exposition aux risques. Capacité à interpréter les plans de gicleurs, de pompes incendie, de systèmes d’extinction et les résultats d’essais hydrauliques. Capacité à analyser des plans architecturaux, structuraux, mécaniques et électriques. Excellente connaissance des codes du bâtiment et de prévention des incendies nord-américains, des normes NFPA ainsi que des normes reconnues de l’industrie telles que Factory Mutual . Capacité démontrée à travailler de façon autonome tout en favorisant un fort esprit de collaboration. Excellentes habiletés en communication et en relations interpersonnelles. Permis de conduire valide et passeport valide ou admissibilité à l’obtenir. Disponibilité à voyager fréquemment (environ 80 % du temps au Québec et 20 % ailleurs au Canada). La maîtrise de l’anglais de niveau intermédiaire avancé est exigée en raison de la nature des tâches, des outils de travail et des interactions fréquentes avec des partenaires, des collègues, des courtiers et des clients anglophones partout au Canada. Mon avantage unique Expérience en gestion de comptes. Expérience auprès d’entrepreneurs et de risques liés au secteur de la construction. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal. About the role At Vasion , we make print intelligent. Intelligent Print Automation treats File > Print as the entry point to a workflow rather than the end of one: the moment a document is created or captured, it becomes structured, secure, auditable data instead of a page that disappears. Three products run on one cloud-native platform — serverless print management that eliminates print servers, drivers, and scripts; output management that moves business-critical ERP print off legacy on-premise infrastructure; and document automation that captures, classifies, and routes documents with AI at the point of capture, built on AWS Bedrock with connectors into Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure AI, and others. More than 14,000 organizations run on the platform, concentrated in healthcare, government, education, financial services, and manufacturing. We are FedRAMP High Authorized, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certified, and SOC 2 Type II audited. This role owns where that platform meets the device: the embedded control panel application (CPA) that runs on multifunction printers from HP, Xerox, Ricoh, Canon, and others. The panel is where a user authenticates, releases a job, and starts a scan — the moment print stops being paper and becomes an intelligent workflow. We are a cloud-native and agent-native product organization, and we expect our product managers to work that way. The panel is where digital transformation meets paper, and our platform is reinventing what happens there — turning that critical physical step in the document lifecycle into the first intelligent one. We are building the AI and cloud-native MFP applications of the future, with no customer infrastructure behind them. Just as we eliminated print servers in print management, we are removing the infrastructure that supports the MFP so the platform meets customers where they already are: any device, any manufacturer, any identity provider, any location, and nothing to install in between. Zero trust by default, and it just works. This role owns that surface — what we build at the panel, which manufacturers get it and in what order, and what the experience becomes for the thousands of organizations that reach us there every day.
